title: The deep learning framework Hist2Prot infers single-cell spatial proteomics from histology to predict biomarkers and clinical outcomes
zh_title: Hist2Prot：由H&E切片推断单细胞空间蛋白组并预测标志物与结局
summary: 深度学习框架在约5100万配对细胞上训练，从常规H&E生成单细胞空间蛋白组谱，并在独立同平台及跨平台数据上评估，优于既有基线。
key_points: 约5100万配对细胞训练
外部评估含约7200万额外细胞
虚拟蛋白保留免疫、基质与肿瘤表型
reason: 病理大规模训练，独立及跨平台外部验证，涉及临床结局，命中偏好
abstract: Spatial proteomics enables high-resolution mapping of protein expression within the tumor microenvironment, but its routine clinical application remains limited by cost, technical complexity and restricted tissue coverage. Here we present Hist2Prot, a deep learning framework that generates single-cell spatial proteomic profiles from routine hematoxylin and eosin histology. Trained on approximately 51 million paired cells from a same-section G4X spatial proteomics dataset, Hist2Prot was evaluated in internal test cohorts, independent same-platform G4X cohorts and external cross-platform datasets comprising approximately 72 million additional cells, showing concordance with measured protein profiles and outperforming established baselines. Hist2Prot-derived virtual proteins preserved immune, stromal and tumor cell phenotypes and recapitulated clinically relevant tumor microenvironment organization. Across seven independent patient cohorts comprising 1,774 patients, virtual spatial proteomics improved molecular biomarker, prognostic and immunotherapy response prediction beyond hematoxylin and eosin morphology alone. Hist2Prot enables scalable single-cell computational spatial proteomics from routine histology for precision oncology.
zh_abstract: 空间蛋白质组学能够在高分辨率下绘制肿瘤微环境中的蛋白表达图谱，但其常规临床应用仍受限于成本、技术复杂性和组织覆盖范围有限。在此，我们提出 Hist2Prot，这是一个深度学习框架，可根据常规苏木精-伊红（H&E）组织学图像生成单细胞空间蛋白质组学图谱。Hist2Prot 在来自同一切片 G4X 空间蛋白质组学数据集的约5100万个配对细胞上训练，并在内部测试队列、独立的同平台 G4X 队列以及包含约7200万个额外细胞的外部跨平台数据集中进行评估，结果显示其与实测蛋白图谱一致，且优于既有基线方法。Hist2Prot 生成的虚拟蛋白保留了免疫细胞、基质细胞和肿瘤细胞的表型，并重现了具有临床意义的肿瘤微环境组织结构。在包含1,774例患者的七个独立患者队列中，虚拟空间蛋白质组学在分子生物标志物、预后及免疫治疗反应预测方面均优于仅使用苏木精-伊红形态学的方法。Hist2Prot 使得基于常规组织学的可扩展单细胞计算空间蛋白质组学成为可能，可服务于精准肿瘤学。

title: Challenges for human oversight in detecting system malfunctions in AI-assisted medical diagnostics
zh_title: AI辅助诊断中人工监督识别系统故障的挑战
summary: 48名医生参与的随机对照研究显示，随着心音听诊AI可靠性下降，医生诊断表现同步下降，信心下降快于对AI的信任。
key_points: 48名医生，AI心脏听诊逐步失灵
即使强制先行判断，诊断表现仍随AI下降
信心下降快于对AI的信任
reason: 随机对照人机研究但样本仅48人，偏人机协作与安全，属值得一看档
abstract: Increasingly, physicians must oversee AI systems to detect system malfunctions. We studied 48 physicians in a randomized controlled study using an increasingly malfunctioning AI for cardiac auscultation. Diagnostic performance declined alongside AI reliability, even when physicians were cognitively forced to make an initial classification, and when human performance exceeded AI reliability. Physicians’ confidence declined faster than their trust in AI. Results call for specification of oversight goals and processes ensuring patient safety.
zh_abstract: 越来越多的情况下，医生必须监督人工智能（AI）系统以发现系统故障。我们在一项随机对照研究中纳入48名医生，使用一个故障逐渐增多的心脏听诊AI。随着AI可靠性下降，诊断表现也随之下降，即使在医生被认知性地要求先做出初步分类时，以及在人类表现优于AI可靠性时，也是如此。医生的信心下降速度快于其对AI的信任。结果提示，需要明确监督目标，并建立确保患者安全的监督流程。

title: Multicenter benchmarking of large language models for bladder cancer management recommendations from mpMRI reports
zh_title: 基于mpMRI报告的膀胱癌管理建议：大语言模型多中心基准评测
summary: 回顾性评估九个LLM在三家医院590份膀胱癌mpMRI报告上的建议质量，比较中文原文与译后英文输入，医生评分共21,240条。
key_points: 遵循TRIPOD-LLM，九个API模型
输入语言对评分的影响因模型而异
两名医生按1–5分独立评分
reason: 多中心回顾性LLM基准，无前瞻/结局，封顶6档
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can interpret radiology reports, but their ability to generate guideline-concordant recommendations from bladder cancer multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) reports remains uncertain. Following TRIPOD-LLM, we retrospectively evaluated nine API-accessed LLMs using 590 mpMRI reports from three hospitals under two input conditions: original Chinese reports and clinician-translated, quality-controlled English reports. Two physicians independently rated each model-generated recommendation on a 1–5 ordinal scale. We analyzed 21,240 ratings using patient-level random-intercept cumulative link mixed models, with paired Wilcoxon tests as secondary exploratory analyses. The association between input condition and physician rating differed across LLMs (likelihood-ratio chi-square = 683.05, df = 8, P < 0.001). Compared with original Chinese input, clinician-translated English input was associated with higher ratings for chatgpt-o3-pro (OR 2.79, 95% CI 2.29–3.41), deepseek-v4-flash (OR 1.46, 95% CI 1.19–1.81), claude-opus-4-7 (OR 3.07, 95% CI 2.47–3.82), and gpt-5.5 (OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.53–2.32), but with lower ratings for claude-sonnet-4-5 (OR 0.29, 95% CI 0.23–0.36; all Holm-adjusted P < 0.001). Four LLMs showed no clear input-condition difference. Center-specific contrasts also depended on input condition and were materially unchanged after adjustment for age, sex, pathological T stage, tumor grade, tumor number, and maximum lesion diameter. Inter-rater agreement was substantial (quadratic weighted kappa range, 0.621–0.743). Readability did not track physician-rated recommendation quality. These findings argue against clinician-translated English as a universal optimization strategy and support model-specific validation of input conditions before clinical deployment. LLM-generated recommendations from mpMRI reports are best positioned as clinician-supervised, imaging-based decision support rather than standalone treatment advice.

title: AI-based prediction of actionable genomic alterations from H&E-stained slides
zh_title: 基于H&E切片的AI预测可干预基因组改变
summary: 视角文章评述从H&E预测可靶向基因改变的证据，提及EAGLE与ANNAR前瞻性试验，并提出整合路径。
key_points: 提及EAGLE、ANNAR前瞻性试验
可用于分诊分子检测或试验入组
提出临床整合的务实路径
reason: 观点类上限6分，主题为病理预测命中偏好
abstract: Precision oncology based on the identification of actionable genomic alterations (AGAs) has been transformative in the care of solid tumors, yet optimal treatment selection is often hindered by tissue exhaustion and slow turnaround times. Artificial intelligence (AI) addresses these barriers by predicting AGAs directly from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained slides. Recent landmark studies, including the prospective EAGLE and ANNAR trials, have demonstrated that deep learning models can identify alterations such as EGFR in non-small cell lung cancer and FGFR in urothelial cancer across diverse global cohorts. By providing near-instant, non-destructive results, AI-based prediction can triage patients for molecular testing or clinical trials at the time of initial diagnosis. This perspective evaluates the maturing evidence base and outlines a pragmatic pathway for integrating these tools into clinical practice. Ultimately, these models offer the opportunity to extract critical molecular information from slides generated in every laboratory worldwide and to significantly improve timely access to the rapidly evolving therapeutic landscape of solid tumors.
zh_abstract: 基于可干预基因组改变（AGA）识别的精准肿瘤学已经改变了实体瘤的诊疗，但最佳治疗选择常受限于组织耗尽和周转时间缓慢。人工智能（AI）可通过直接从常规苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色切片预测 AGA 来解决这些障碍。包括前瞻性 EAGLE 和 ANNAR 试验在内的近期里程碑式研究表明，深度学习模型能够在不同的全球队列中识别诸如非小细胞肺癌中的 EGFR 和尿路上皮癌中的 FGFR 等改变。通过提供近乎即时、无损的结果，基于 AI 的预测可在初次诊断时对患者进行分流，以便进行分子检测或参加临床试验。本文观点评估了日趋成熟的证据基础，并概述了将这些工具整合进临床实践的务实路径。最终，这些模型有望从全球每个实验室产生的切片中提取关键分子信息，并显著改善患者及时获得快速发展的实体瘤治疗手段的机会。

title: Enhanced skin tone and blood estimation through AI-enabled upscaling of discrete reflectance spectra
zh_title: AI 光谱上采样提升肤色黑色素与血液估计
summary: 用漫反射光谱和全连接神经网络，从稀疏数据上采样估计黑色素与血容量，在仿体、猪皮和人体中验证。
key_points: 仿体中 R2>0.90
猪皮黑色素估计与组织学密度相关 r=0.95
可用于脉搏血氧仪肤色偏差评估
reason: 多层验证但样本规模有限，无外部队列，值得一看档
abstract: Objective quantification of epidermal melanin content and dermal blood volume is crucial for equitable applications in dermatology and in the evaluation and engineering of optical devices, such as pulse oximeters, where variable amounts of melanin may introduce inaccuracies. Here, we demonstrate a method leveraging diffuse reflectance spectroscopy and a machine-learning framework using fully connected neural networks (FCNNs) to non-invasively estimate melanin and blood indices from sparse data through spectral upscaling. We validated the algorithm on custom phantoms, porcine skin, and in vivo human participants. In phantoms with variable blood and melanin (0–20%), the model achieved high accuracy (R2 > 0.90) to absolute concentrations. In porcine skin, estimated melanin strongly correlated with histology-derived density scores (Pearson r = 0.95). Across six regions of the human hand, the FCNN accurately estimated pigmentation from sparse wavelengths, even during hand-raise challenges that induce confounding blood volume changes. After upscaling, sparse-wavelength estimates strongly correlated with a model using over 450 wavelengths (Pearson r = 0.96), reducing data requirements ~ 150-fold without compromising accuracy. These findings highlight the importance of high-spectral information for disentangling melanin and blood contributions in reflectance spectra and the capacity of machine-learning to restore predictive performance from sparse inputs. These findings demonstrate that artificial-intelligence -driven spectral upscaling can enhance objective skin tone quantification in wearable optical devices.
zh_abstract: 客观量化表皮黑色素含量和真皮血容量，对于皮肤病学领域的公平应用，以及对脉搏血氧仪等光学设备的评估与工程设计至关重要，因为黑色素含量的差异可能导致这类设备出现不准确。在此，我们展示了一种方法：利用漫反射光谱和采用全连接神经网络（FCNN）的机器学习框架，通过光谱升尺度（spectral upscaling），基于稀疏数据无创估计黑色素和血液指数。我们在定制体模、猪皮肤和在体人类受试者中验证了该算法。在血液和黑色素含量可变（0–20%）的体模中，模型对绝对浓度的估计达到较高准确度（R2 > 0.90）。在猪皮肤中，估计的黑色素与组织学得出的密度评分高度相关（Pearson r = 0.95）。在人手的六个区域中，即使在会引起混杂性血容量变化的抬手激发试验期间，FCNN 仍能依据稀疏波长准确估计色素沉着。升尺度之后，稀疏波长的估计结果与使用 450 个以上波长的模型高度相关（Pearson r = 0.96），在不影响准确度的情况下将数据需求降低了约 150 倍。这些发现凸显了高光谱信息对于在反射光谱中区分黑色素与血液贡献的重要性，以及机器学习从稀疏输入中恢复预测性能的能力。这些发现表明，人工智能驱动的光谱升尺度可增强可穿戴光学设备中对肤色的客观量化。

title: Deep learning detection and biological interpretation of arterial stiffness from retinal fundus images in diabetes.
zh_title: 眼底图像深度学习预测糖尿病患者动脉僵硬度
summary: 多中心研究用64,440张眼底图像训练模型预测动脉僵硬，外部验证AUC为0.772，融合临床因素后外部AUC为0.801。
key_points: 训练于36,412名糖尿病成人
两家独立医院外部验证6,217张图像
融合临床因素后外部AUC 0.801
reason: 多中心大样本外部验证，眼科影像加分
abstract: [iScience] Pulse wave velocity is the gold standard for assessing arterial stiffness (AS) but is costly and not widely accessible. This multicenter study developed a deep learning model to predict AS from fundus images. Trained on 64,440 images from 36,412 adults with diabetes at China's National Metabolic Management Centers and externally validated on 6,217 images from two independent hospitals, the model achieved an AUC of 0.780 (95% CI: 0.769-0.792) and 0.772 (95% CI: 0.754-0.790) in internal and external validation, respectively, outperforming models using classical risk factors alone. The fusion model integrating fundus images with clinical factors significantly improved test-set performance (AUC = 0.853, 95% CI: 0.844-0.863) and demonstrated good external generalizability (AUC = 0.801, 95% CI: 0.784-0.816). Ablation studies indicated retinal arteries were associated with AS, with other retinal structures also contributing. These findings support deep-learning-based fundus-image analysis for AS screening in real-world clinical settings, and retinal-structure analyses for exploring AS pathophysiology.

title: Curiosity-0826-4B: Generative Medical Event Sequence Modeling Across Pediatric and Adult Populations
zh_title: Curiosity-0826-4B：覆盖儿童与成人的生成式医疗事件序列模型
summary: 基于 Epic Cosmos 训练的生成式医疗事件基础模型更新版，模拟患者时间线以进行零样本临床预测，纳入更广人群与更丰富事件表示。
key_points: 整体持平或优于前代 Curiosity-0226-1B，化验值预测 MAE 降低 18–46%
儿童哮喘新诊断 AUROC 0.742–0.785，加重 0.829–0.852，与成人相当
镰状细胞危象儿童 AUROC 0.820–0.847，低于成人的 0.915
reason: 大规模患者级纵向基础模型、覆盖儿童与成人；预印本，外部验证信息有限
abstract: We introduce Curiosity-0826-4B, an updated version of the generative medical event foundation model trained on Epic Cosmos that simulates patient timelines to produce zero-shot clinical predictions. Curiosity-0826-4B incorporates a broader patient population and richer clinical event representations, while generally matching or exceeding Curiosity-0226-1B, the largest model in the previous Curiosity-0226 series, on evaluated tasks supported by both models. Laboratory value prediction improved, with MAE 18--46% lower than that of Curiosity-0226-1B. We evaluated prediction of disease events across pediatric cohorts aged 2--17 years. AUROCs for new asthma diagnosis (0.742--0.785) and asthma exacerbation (0.829--0.852) were comparable to those in the adult reference cohort, while AUROCs for sickle cell crisis (0.820--0.847) were lower than in adults (0.915). Explicit representation of documented death enabled new mortality prediction tasks among adults across hospice, inpatient, and ambulatory settings (AUROC 0.821--0.942). Scaling-law analysis guided compute-optimal initial pretraining followed by continued pretraining with context extension. The resulting Curiosity-0826-4B model has more parameters (4.3B versus 1B) and a longer context window (16K versus 8K). It processes 56% fewer training tokens and requires 2.2 times the training floating point operations (FLOPs) compared with its predecessor. By extending a common zero-shot prediction strategy to pediatric patients and additional outcomes, Curiosity-0826-4B broadens opportunities to develop clinical and operational applications without training separate task-specific models. Further validation should assess local calibration, performance across patient subgroups and event frequencies, timeline completion rates, and generalization to new settings, alongside prospective evaluation of clinical and operational utility.
zh_abstract: 我们介绍 Curiosity-0826-4B，这是在 Epic Cosmos 上训练的生成式医疗事件基础模型的更新版本，可模拟患者时间线以产生零样本临床预测。Curiosity-0826-4B 纳入了更广泛的患者群体和更丰富的临床事件表示，在两个模型均支持的评估任务上，总体上与此前 Curiosity-0226 系列中最大的模型 Curiosity-0226-1B 相当或更优。实验室检验值预测有所改善，MAE 比 Curiosity-0226-1B 低 18%–46%。我们评估了 2–17 岁儿科队列中疾病事件的预测。新发哮喘诊断（0.742–0.785）和哮喘急性发作（0.829–0.852）的 AUROC 与成人参照队列相当，而镰状细胞危象的 AUROC（0.820–0.847）低于成人（0.915）。对已记录死亡的显式表示使得在成人的临终关怀、住院和门诊场景中可开展新的死亡率预测任务（AUROC 0.821–0.942）。缩放定律分析指导了计算最优的初始预训练，随后进行带上下文扩展的持续预训练。最终的 Curiosity-0826-4B 模型参数更多（4.3B 对 1B），上下文窗口更长（16K 对 8K）。与其前代相比，它处理的训练 token 少 56%，所需训练浮点运算量（FLOPs）为前者的 2.2 倍。通过将常见的零样本预测策略扩展到儿科患者和更多结局，Curiosity-0826-4B 拓宽了无需训练单独的任务特定模型即可开发临床和运营应用的机会。进一步的验证应评估本地校准、不同患者亚组和事件频率下的表现、时间线完成率以及向新场景的泛化，并对临床和运营效用进行前瞻性评估。

title: Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks
zh_title: 评估预训练语言语义在结构化EHR预测中的作用
summary: tEHR用事件自然语言描述，对因果语言模型做EHR持续预训练并LoRA微调，在MIMIC-IV四项任务及CPRD胰腺癌预测上评估。
key_points: 以文本描述表示结构化EHR事件
持续预训练加LoRA微调
MIMIC-IV与CPRD上评估，基于Mistral-7B
reason: 纵向患者编码新方法，多数据集评估，预印本，命中偏好
abstract: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event. As a result, relationships between concepts must largely be learned from EHR co-occurrence, without directly exploiting any prior semantic knowledge. We investigate how pretrained causal language models can be adapted for longitudinal EHR prediction by developing tEHR. Here, we represent events with their natural language description and use this text stream to apply EHR-adaptive continued pretraining, followed by task-specific discriminative fine-tuning using LoRA, utilising the LLM as a longitudinal patient-encoder. We evaluate this approach across four prediction tasks on the MIMIC-IV dataset and pancreatic cancer prediction on the CPRD dataset at 1 to 12 month horizons, with tEHR using the Mistral-7B-v0.3 backbone achieving the strongest overall performance. Ablations show that performance declines when clinical descriptions are removed or misaligned, when numerical values are omitted, and when either stage of adaptation is removed, while explicit elapsed-time descriptions provide little additional benefit. Analysis of the learned patient representations further reveals clinically coherent structure associated with distinct patterns of disease risk and clinical history.
zh_abstract: 结构化电子健康记录（EHR）模型通常将每个临床概念视为特定于数据集的 token，从而丢弃了与该事件相关的自然语言语义。因此，概念之间的关系主要只能从 EHR 的共现中学习，而无法直接利用任何先验语义知识。我们通过开发 tEHR，研究如何将预训练的因果语言模型用于纵向 EHR 预测。在此，我们用自然语言描述来表示事件，并利用该文本流进行 EHR 适应性的持续预训练，随后使用 LoRA 进行任务特异性的判别式微调，将大语言模型（LLM）用作纵向患者编码器。我们在 MIMIC-IV 数据集的四项预测任务以及 CPRD 数据集的胰腺癌预测（预测时间范围为 1 至 12 个月）上评估了该方法，其中以 Mistral-7B-v0.3 为骨干网络的 tEHR 取得了总体最强的性能。消融实验显示，当去除或错配临床描述、省略数值、或去除任一适应阶段时，性能均下降，而显式的时间间隔描述几乎未带来额外获益。对所学患者表征的分析进一步揭示了临床上连贯的结构，这些结构与不同的疾病风险模式和临床病史相关。

title: Your Vision Foundation Model Is Secretly an EEG Foundation Model
zh_title: SeeEEG：冻结视觉基础模型作为EEG编码器
summary: 将EEG渲染为图像，用冻结视觉Transformer作编码器，只学习显示方式，声称优于专用EEG基础模型（预印本）。
key_points: EEG专用基础模型冻结特征迁移较差
通道按行排布为波形或尺度图
仅学习显示参数，视觉主干冻结
reason: 新颖方法且挑战EEG基础模型，预印本证据有限
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are pretrained on thousands of hours of recordings, yet their frozen features transfer poorly to downstream tasks, and this transfer does not consistently improve with larger models or more pretraining data. We show that a vision foundation model that has never seen EEG is a stronger frozen EEG encoder than these specialized models, once the signals are rendered as images that a vision transformer can read. Our method, SeeEEG, keeps the vision backbone frozen and learns only how EEG is displayed to it. Each channel occupies a dedicated row of patches and is drawn either as a waveform at a fixed gain or as a scalogram whose frequency range spans the patch height, so that task-relevant patterns fall within individual tokens. The montage, filtering, and contrast parameters of this display are initialized from a standard clinical montage and optimized with the task loss through the frozen backbone, which amounts to at most 1,113 trainable parameters per view. We compare SeeEEG with seven EEG foundation models on eight clinical, sleep, affective, and brain-computer interface datasets, with every encoder frozen and paired with identical readout heads. With a frozen DINOv3 ViT-B, SeeEEG outperforms every EEG foundation model in balanced accuracy on all eight datasets and reaches a mean rank of 1.3 in Cohen kappa or AUROC, compared with 2.9 for the strongest baseline, REVE. The learned displays transfer without further optimization to the video encoder V-JEPA 2.1, which outperforms every EEG foundation model on both metrics on six of the eight datasets. Replacing DINOv3 with a randomly initialized ViT-B lowers the score by 15.2 points on average, so the ability to read rendered EEG comes from visual pretraining.

abstract: Anti-cancer drug response prediction (DRP) is critically important for precision oncology and therapeutic development. Currently, most DRP models are developed using drug screening data from immortalized cancer cell lines, which can differ substantially from patient tumors at the genomic and molecular levels, even though patient tumor response is the ultimate prediction target. To help bridge this gap and bring DRP models closer to their intended clinical application, we conducted four drug screening studies using patient-derived organoids (PDOs), which more faithfully recapitulate patient tumors than immortalized cell lines. These studies generated data for improving and evaluating DRP models, including multi-omics profiles of PDO lines, drug feature data, and treatment response measurements. Using these data, we retrained and evaluated multiple publicly available DRP models under three model-building scenarios: training models using cell line data only, training models using combined cell line and PDO data, and pretraining models on cell line data followed by fine-tuning on PDO data. We then evaluated and compared model prediction performance on PDOs across these analysis scenarios. In addition, we also assessed the consistency of drug screening viability data generated by different laboratories using different assay technologies and/or experimental protocols.

abstract: Deep-learning-based magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction holds great promise for accelerating acquisitions, yet its clinical translation remains bottlenecked by poor generalizability across unseen scanners, populations, anatomies, and protocols. Gathering sufficiently diverse clinical datasets to overcome this bottleneck is hindered by high acquisition costs, privacy restrictions, and institutional biases. Here, we introduce Scalable Inverse Model (SIM), a framework that systematically co-designs physics-simulated training data, model architecture, and learning paradigms around scalability--leveraging compute scaling to overcome historical data bottlenecks and achieve robust zero-shot MRI reconstruction. Across 14 public and in-house datasets--spanning seven international centers, five vendors, field strengths of 0.3-7 T, over ten anatomical regions, more than ten acquisition protocols, downstream quantitative and molecular tasks, and a 150-scan blinded radiologist study--SIM demonstrates robust zero-shot generalizability, recovering fine anatomical details while suppressing aliasing artifacts where conventional deep-learning methods fail. Attention-map analyses confirm that SIM learns physically explainable, dynamically adaptive reconstruction primitives rather than anatomy-specific priors. SIM establishes a scalable, privacy-preserving, and democratized infrastructure for universal MRI reconstruction, providing a blueprint for generalizable AI across inverse problems in medical imaging.

abstract: Autonomous AI agents are increasingly used to automate biomedical research, creating a growing need to benchmark their capabilities on real scientific data and workflows. Their reliability in neuroimaging remains insufficiently characterized, where plausible analytical outputs can conceal errors that affect scientific conclusions. Existing studies have advanced scientific question answering and tool-based automation, but provide limited evidence on workflow reconstruction, acquisition of procedural expertise and evidence-based scientific judgment. Here we present NIBench, a neuroimaging benchmark comprising three complementary evaluations of autonomous agents. First, we benchmark execution and workflow reconstruction using 56 tasks across seven tool ecosystems, covering structural, diffusion and functional magnetic resonance imaging, positron emission tomography and multimodal analyses. Second, we examine whether agents can evolve their procedural skills through distillation of execution trajectories, evaluating the resulting skills on previously encountered tasks, unseen tasks and other models. Third, we assess scientific judgment using 36 claims from published Alzheimer's disease studies, requiring agents to analyse raw cohort data and provide reproducible evidence. We evaluate 19 language models within a shared agent framework, with selected models undergoing skill distillation and claim evaluation. Leading agents execute supplied analysis protocols nearly perfectly, whereas withholding procedural guidance widens performance differences. Distilled skills improve performance on acquisition tasks and transfer between models, but benefits on unseen tasks are inconsistent. Agents reproduce their reported results yet sometimes reach conclusions inconsistent with expert-derived answers, and access to data does not always improve judgment.

abstract: The development of foundation models that learn a general grammar of DNA (DNA language models) has accelerated in recent years. The vast majority of DNA large language models (LLMs), such as DNABERT-2 and Nucleotide Transformer, are pretrained almost exclusively on reference genomes. They therefore cannot represent the two sources of variation most directly tied to regulatory differences between people: genetic variants and DNA methylation. Long-read sequencing (Nanopore and PacBio) now measures both from the same native DNA molecules, but no model is designed to use this joint readout. With this in mind, we developed ModBERT, a DNA language model built on a five-letter probabilistic genome representation in which each position is a distribution over A, C, G, T, 5mC (represented with M). In pretraining, these distributions encode population allele frequencies and CpG methylation levels from 242 individuals in the 1000 Genomes Long-Read Sequencing Consortium, learned with a soft-target masked language modeling objective. We further propose probabilistic fine-tuning, in which the same representation encodes one individual's genotype and methylation. A fine-tuned model can then make person-specific predictions from a single assay. Under this novel fine-tuning framework, we show that ModBERT effectively utilizes methylation information to classify peaks from functional genomic assays, including histone mark (n=11 different marks) and transcription factor binding (n=69 TFs) ChIP-seq data, outperforming ab initio trained models and ModBERT pretrained on sequences without methylation. In silico methylation perturbations yield TF sensitivities that correlate with independent methylation-aware motif models. Using an evaluation design that separates generalization to new loci from generalization to new individuals, ModBERT predicts chromatin accessibility at held-out loci in held-out individuals (AUROC 0.88). Its predicted variant effects agree with likely causal caQTLs (Spearman correlation = 0.52) but not with variants associated only through linkage, a traditionally challenging task. Overall, ModBERT establishes a framework for personal-genome language modeling, in which a model reads each individual's genetic and epigenetic sequence rather than a shared reference. zh_abstract: 近年来，学习DNA通用语法的基础模型（DNA语言模型）的发展不断加速。绝大多数DNA大语言模型（LLM），如DNABERT-2和Nucleotide Transformer，几乎完全基于参考基因组进行预训练，因此无法表示与个体间调控差异最直接相关的两类变异来源：遗传变异和DNA甲基化。长读长测序（Nanopore和PacBio）现已能够在同一天然DNA分子上同时测量这两者，但目前尚无模型被设计用于利用这种联合读数。基于此，我们开发了ModBERT，这是一种基于五字母概率性基因组表示的DNA语言模型，其中每个位置是在A、C、G、T、5mC（以M表示）上的一个分布。在预训练中，这些分布编码了来自1000 Genomes Long-Read Sequencing Consortium的242名个体的群体等位基因频率和CpG甲基化水平，并通过软目标掩码语言建模目标进行学习。我们进一步提出了概率性微调，即用同一种表示来编码单个个体的基因型和甲基化。经微调的模型随后可根据单一检测做出个体特异性预测。在这一新的微调框架下，我们证明ModBERT能有效利用甲基化信息对功能基因组检测中的峰进行分类，包括组蛋白修饰（n=11种不同修饰）和转录因子结合（n=69个TF）的ChIP-seq数据，其表现优于从头训练的模型以及在不含甲基化的序列上预训练的ModBERT。计算机模拟的甲基化扰动所得到的TF敏感性与独立的甲基化感知基序模型相关。采用将对新位点的泛化与对新个体的泛化区分开来的评估设计，ModBERT可在留出个体的留出位点上预测染色质可及性（AUROC 0.88）。其预测的变异效应与可能的因果caQTL一致（Spearman相关系数=0.52），而与仅因连锁而相关的变异不一致，这在传统上是一项具有挑战性的任务。总体而言，ModBERT建立了个人基因组语言建模的框架，即模型读取每个个体的遗传和表观遗传序列，而非共享的参考序列。随着群体规模的长读长队列的出现，这使得能够在计算机上剖析变异和甲基化对基因调控的影响，并对候选位点进行有原则的优先排序以供实验验证。

abstract: Autoregressive electronic health record (EHR) foundation models may disclose training information at inference, yet clinical predictability makes patient-specific memorisation difficult to distinguish from generalisation. We evaluate fixed-window token reconstruction, sensitive-attribute disclosure, and random patient-level canaries in GPT-2-style models trained on MIMIC-IV, across early, best-validation, and final checkpoints. Reconstruction improves with additional context, but training--held-out differences remain small. Trajectory-unique prompts containing limited clinical information produce no excess sensitive disclosure for training patients. In a matched model with random binary patient-level canaries, training-patient label-recovery AUROC increases from 0.512 to 0.549 while held-out recovery remains at chance. An overfit 1,000-patient positive control achieves near-perfect recovery, confirming sensitivity to strong memorisation. These results reveal weak cohort-level memorisation but no reliable patient-level disclosure under the evaluated attacks. They motivate clinically grounded inference-time audits that can detect patient-specific memorisation in existing models without retraining with canaries.
zh_abstract: 自回归电子健康记录（EHR）基础模型在推理时可能泄露训练信息，但由于临床可预测性，难以将针对特定患者的记忆与泛化区分开来。我们在基于MIMIC-IV训练的GPT-2风格模型上，针对早期、最佳验证和最终检查点，评估了固定窗口词元重建、敏感属性泄露以及随机患者级金丝雀（canary）。随着上下文增加，重建效果有所提高，但训练集与保留集之间的差异仍然很小。包含有限临床信息的轨迹唯一提示，并未对训练患者产生超额的敏感信息泄露。在带有随机二元患者级金丝雀的匹配模型中，训练患者的标签恢复AUROC从0.512升至0.549，而保留集的恢复水平仍处于随机水平。一个过拟合的1,000例患者阳性对照实现了近乎完美的恢复，证实了该方法对强记忆的敏感性。这些结果显示存在较弱的队列水平记忆，但在所评估的攻击下没有可靠的患者水平泄露。这些结果推动开展以临床为基础的推理时审计，使其能够在无需使用金丝雀重新训练的情况下，检测现有模型中针对特定患者的记忆。

abstract: [Journal of computational biology : a journal of computational molecular cell biology] Multispecific antibodies (msAbs) offer transformative therapeutic potential by engaging multiple epitopes simultaneously, yet their efficacy is an emergent property governed by complex molecular architectures. Rational design is often bottlenecked by the inability to predict how subtle changes in domain topology influence functional outcomes, a challenge exacerbated by the scarcity of comprehensive experimental data. Here, we introduce Synapse, a biologically inspired synthetic benchmark for topology-aware modeling of msAbs. First, we present a generative method that combines nonlinear per-domain sequence-to-score landscapes with connectivity-dependent synthetic readouts. Second, we propose a graph neural network architecture that explicitly encodes these topological constraints, distinguishing between format configurations that appear identical to the evaluated connectivity-agnostic multilayer perceptron. We demonstrate that this model learns topology-dependent structure-function relationships on synthetic landscapes and evaluate a transfer learning workflow as infrastructure for adaptation to biological datasets. We showcase our framework with a trispecific T cell engager-inspired synthetic topology-dependent optimization task and a constrained ranking of common light chain candidates against a composite objective. This work provides a controlled benchmarking environment for developing and evaluating topology-aware computational tools for msAb modeling. All experiments use synthetic data; no biological validation is performed.

abstract: Quantifying disease-associated renal tubular remodeling is challenging because tubular appearances are heterogeneous. We introduce TuMAP (Tubular Morphotype-Aware Pathomics), a pipeline combining (1) dual-view foundation-model representations and provisional morphotype annotation, (2) compositional and within-morphotype pathomics, and (3) patient-level statistical inference. From 456,158 tubules in 358 PAS-stained kidney biopsy slides, TuMAP identified eight image-based morphotypes, seven of which showed stable subsampling assignments. Across 219 patients in six diagnostic groups, diabetic nephropathy (DN) and tubulointerstitial nephritis/acute tubular injury (TIN/ATI) each differed from minimal change disease in seven morphotype proportions, while IgA nephropathy differed in six. DN showed reduced nuclear solidity and increased eccentricity across all eight morphotypes. Area-normalized nuclear density exposed additional within-morphotype differences. TuMAP provides a framework for separating changes in tubular morphotype composition from phenotypic differences within morphotypes.
zh_abstract: 量化与疾病相关的肾小管重塑具有挑战性，因为肾小管的外观具有异质性。我们提出 TuMAP（Tubular Morphotype-Aware Pathomics，肾小管形态类型感知病理组学），这是一个整合了以下三部分的流程：（1）双视图基础模型表征和临时形态类型标注，（2）组成性及形态类型内病理组学分析，以及（3）患者水平的统计推断。TuMAP 基于 358 张 PAS 染色肾活检切片中的 456,158 个肾小管，识别出八种基于图像的形态类型，其中七种在子采样分配中表现稳定。在六个诊断组共 219 例患者中，糖尿病肾病（DN）和肾小管间质性肾炎/急性肾小管损伤（TIN/ATI）各自在七种形态类型的比例上与微小病变病不同，而 IgA 肾病在六种上不同。DN 在全部八种形态类型中均表现为核实度（nuclear solidity）降低和偏心率增加。面积归一化的核密度揭示了形态类型内部的更多差异。TuMAP 提供了一个框架，用于区分肾小管形态类型组成的变化与形态类型内部的表型差异。

title: Predicting Ethanol Drinking Status from Nonhuman Primate Liver Histology: A Proof of Concept for Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Few-Shot Vision-Language Modeling
zh_title: 基于非人灵长类肝组织病理预测饮酒状态：少样本VLM的PEFT概念验证
summary: 在MATRR子集上评估视觉-语言模型结合参数高效微调用于少样本WSI分类，所有PEFT配置均优于非PEFT基线。
key_points: 四样本下ABMIL为43.5%，加适配器后为78.1%
文本通路适配产生局部化注意力热图
视觉通路适配的注意力更弥散
reason: 病理VLM+PEFT新方法有基线对比，但为动物模型概念验证、证据有限
abstract: Combining vision-language models (VLMs) with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising approach to few-shot whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology. This study evaluates this approach for predicting ethanol drinking status from nonhuman primate liver histology. Adapters are evaluated against non-PEFT configurations on a subset of the Monkey Alcohol Tissue Research Resource (MATRR). All evaluated PEFT configurations achieve higher mean balanced accuracy than the non-PEFT baselines. For example, in the four-shot setting, attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) alone achieves 43.5% mean balanced accuracy, compared with 78.1% after adding an adapter. Qualitative attention analysis shows that textual pathway adaptations produce localized attention heatmaps, while visual pathway adaptations produce more diffuse ones. A pathologist's review identified similar histological features across adaptations.
zh_abstract: 将视觉-语言模型（VLM）与参数高效微调（PEFT）相结合，为计算病理学中的少样本全切片图像（WSI）分类提供了一种有前景的方法。本研究评估了该方法在根据非人灵长类动物肝脏组织学预测乙醇饮用状态方面的表现。在猴酒精组织研究资源库（MATRR）的一个子集上，将适配器（adapter）与非 PEFT 配置进行了比较评估。所有评估的 PEFT 配置的平均平衡准确率均高于非 PEFT 基线。例如，在四样本（four-shot）设置下，单独使用基于注意力的多示例学习（ABMIL）的平均平衡准确率为 43.5%，加入适配器后为 78.1%。定性注意力分析显示，文本通路的适配产生局部化的注意力热图，而视觉通路的适配产生更为弥散的注意力热图。病理学家的审阅发现，不同适配方式识别出了相似的组织学特征。

title: TransXplainRRG: A Radiologist-Evaluated LVLM for Chest Radiograph Report Generation
zh_title: TransXplainRRG：经放射科医师评估的胸片报告生成LVLM
summary: 基于Swin Transformer与文本编码器并纳入病史生成胸片报告，并提出仅提取异常发现的专家引导精炼方法。
key_points: 结合患者病史生成放射报告
专家引导“由内而外”提取异常发现
经放射科医师评估强调可解释性
reason: 有新意的预印本方法并有医师评估，但证据有限；多模态VLM小幅上调
abstract: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLM) enhance X-ray report generation, but often neglect clinical context, overlook workflow integration, and lack explainability, which hinders clinical adoption due to interpretability and reliability concerns. This paper addresses the dual challenges of performance and expert explainability in automated X-ray report generation for clinical AI applications. Our proposed approach, TransXplainRRG, utilises an off-the-shelf Swin Transformer model along with a transformer-based text encoder that incorporates patient medical history to generate a radiology report. Further, we explore an expert-guided `inside-out' approach and extract only abnormal findings for radiology report refinement. Thus, this study bridges the gap between high-performance automation and interpretability critical for clinical practice by combining state-of-the-art transformer-based vision encoders, text encoders, and LLMs. TransXplainRRG is trained and tested on the large-scale MIMIC-CXR dataset and further evaluated on the unseen IU X-Ray dataset to demonstrate its generalizability and robustness. We employed the GREEN metric as a complementary measure of clinical consistency, achieving scores of 0.327 on MIMIC-CXR and 0.605 on IU X-Ray, both higher than those achieved by MAIRA-2 under the same evaluation setting. It also performed competitively across standard evaluation metrics, frequently matching or surpassing state-of-the-art models. Additionally, we introduce qualitative evaluation metrics developed from radiologists' viewpoints and conduct a preliminary radiologist evaluation on 100 generated reports to assess their clinical relevance. Quantitative and qualitative analyses further demonstrate the potential of our TransXplainRRG framework for reliable and explainable radiology report generation.
zh_abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）的最新进展提升了X线报告生成能力，但常常忽视临床背景、未考虑工作流程整合且缺乏可解释性，由于对可解释性和可靠性的担忧，这阻碍了其临床应用。本文针对临床AI应用中自动化X线报告生成在性能与专家可解释性方面的双重挑战。我们提出的方法TransXplainRRG利用现成的Swin Transformer模型以及纳入患者病史的基于Transformer的文本编码器来生成放射学报告。此外，我们探索了一种专家引导的“由内而外”方法，仅提取异常发现用于放射学报告的优化。因此，本研究通过结合最先进的基于Transformer的视觉编码器、文本编码器和LLM，弥合了高性能自动化与对临床实践至关重要的可解释性之间的差距。TransXplainRRG在大规模MIMIC-CXR数据集上训练和测试，并在未见过的IU X-Ray数据集上进一步评估，以证明其泛化性和稳健性。我们采用GREEN指标作为临床一致性的补充度量，在MIMIC-CXR和IU X-Ray上分别获得0.327和0.605的分数，在相同评估设置下均高于MAIRA-2。在标准评估指标上其表现同样具有竞争力，经常与最先进模型相当或超越之。此外，我们引入了从放射科医师视角制定的定性评估指标，并对100份生成的报告进行了初步的放射科医师评估，以评价其临床相关性。定量和定性分析进一步表明了我们的TransXplainRRG框架在可靠且可解释的放射学报告生成方面的潜力。

title: Enrollees and Early Lessons from an Agentic Healthcare Platform with Physicians in the Loop
zh_title: 医生在环的智能体医疗平台：参与者特征与早期经验
summary: 描述Lotus AI平台3223名注册用户特征并与全国基准对比，发现慢病患病率更高、就诊分散，功能性疾病用户产生更多医生升级。
key_points: 3223名用户，中位年龄51岁
慢病患病率高于NHIS估计4至7个百分点
功能性疾病用户医生升级更多
reason: 真实部署的描述性预印本，无结局评估
abstract: Agentic healthcare platforms that combine large language models with physician oversight are growing quickly, but little is known about who uses them. We characterized 3,223 enrollees of Lotus AI, a free, physician-supervised agentic platform, who completed onboarding, messaged the agent, and had a linked health record between February and July 2026, and compared them with national benchmarks. Median age was 51 years and 62% were male. Chronic condition prevalence exceeded 2024 National Health Interview Survey estimates in every age band by 4 to 7 percentage points; 18% had a functional or symptom-defined disorder; among the 30% with four or more ambulatory visits in the prior year, care was spread across nearly five providers, with 44% meeting a threshold for high fragmentation. Users with functional disorders generated 1.8 times as many physician escalations and 2.6 times as many laboratory orders as other users, but no more prescriptions. This profile differs from the younger, predominantly female populations reported for direct-to-consumer telemedicine. It moves chronic disease management, functional disorder pathways, and care coordination from aspirations to design requirements, and we argue that deployed AI care platforms should characterize their populations against national benchmarks early.
zh_abstract: 将大语言模型与医师监督相结合的智能体（agentic）医疗平台正在快速增长，但对其使用者知之甚少。我们对 Lotus AI（一个免费、有医师监督的智能体平台）的 3,223 名注册用户进行了特征描述，这些用户在 2026 年 2 月至 7 月间完成了入组流程、向智能体发送了消息并关联了健康记录，并将其与全国基准进行比较。中位年龄为 51 岁，62% 为男性。在每个年龄段，慢性病患病率均比 2024 年全国健康访谈调查（National Health Interview Survey）估计值高 4 至 7 个百分点；18% 患有功能性或以症状定义的疾病；在前一年门诊就诊 4 次及以上的 30% 用户中，其诊疗分散于近 5 位医疗提供者，44% 达到高度碎片化的阈值。患有功能性疾病的用户产生的医师升级转介数是其他用户的 1.8 倍，实验室检查医嘱数是其 2.6 倍，但处方数并无增加。这一画像不同于直接面向消费者的远程医疗所报告的较年轻、以女性为主的人群。它使慢性病管理、功能性疾病路径和诊疗协调从愿景转变为设计要求，我们认为已部署的 AI 医疗平台应尽早依据全国基准对其人群进行特征描述。

title: Bloom unifies brain cell representations across modalities and contexts
zh_title: Bloom：跨模态与情境统一脑细胞表征
summary: Bloom 是基于 Transformer 的模型，用基因表达和/或染色质可及性表示细胞，仅用 30 万小鼠脑细胞训练，在细胞类型解析与注释等任务上优于单模态模型。
key_points: 训练数据比同类预训练模型少约 100 倍
结合基因组序列嵌入与多模态细胞视图
注意力模式揭示细胞类型相关关联
reason: 新方法有基线对比但为预印本，证据有限；基础模型方向略加分
abstract: Multimodal genomic datasets now profile mammalian brain cells across anatomical regions, developmental stages, disease states, and species. Learning shared representations that capture cellular diversity across these heterogeneous observations remains a central challenge. Here, we introduce Bloom, a transformer-based model that represents cells using gene expression, chromatin accessibility, or both. Bloom is trained on 300,000 adult mouse brain cells with paired measurements, randomly sampled with broad-subclass balancing--approximately 100-fold fewer cells than used by comparable pre-trained models. By combining genomic sequence embeddings with randomly sampled multimodal cell views, Bloom outperforms unimodal cell models in resolving brain-wide cell types and in annotation, regression, and label-transfer tasks. Its attention patterns reveal cell-type-dependent associations among genomic loci, including pairs separated by millions of base pairs. These results establish Bloom as a data-efficient framework for integrating multimodal brain cell measurements and generating hypotheses about cell-type-specific genomic relationships.
zh_abstract: 多模态基因组数据集如今已能刻画跨解剖区域、发育阶段、疾病状态和物种的哺乳动物脑细胞。学习能够捕捉这些异质观测中细胞多样性的共享表征，仍是一项核心挑战。在此，我们提出 Bloom，一种基于 transformer 的模型，可利用基因表达、染色质可及性或二者来表示细胞。Bloom 在 300,000 个具有配对测量的成年小鼠脑细胞上训练，这些细胞经随机抽样并按大类亚型均衡——所用细胞数比可比的预训练模型少约 100 倍。通过将基因组序列嵌入与随机抽样的多模态细胞视图相结合，Bloom 在解析全脑细胞类型以及注释、回归和标签迁移任务上优于单模态细胞模型。其注意力模式揭示了基因组位点之间依赖细胞类型的关联，包括相隔数百万碱基对的位点对。这些结果表明，Bloom 是一种整合多模态脑细胞测量并生成细胞类型特异性基因组关系假设的数据高效框架。

title: Unsupervised Deep Learning for Cryo-EM/ET Particle Classification
zh_title: 用于冷冻电镜/电子断层扫描颗粒分类的无监督深度学习
summary: 提出基于自编码器的多阶段无监督框架，联合优化位姿与结构，用于冷冻电镜/断层扫描颗粒图像分类。
key_points: 可捕捉单颗粒视角的连续变化
能区分真实颗粒与污染物
在多蛋白混合模拟数据上展示分离能力
reason: 有新意的结构生物学方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) is widely used to determine protein structures from purified samples. With cryogenic electron tomography (cryo-ET), it is possible to image thin sections of cells and directly visualize diverse proteins in their native environment. However, separating the massive mixture of different types of proteins inside cells remains challenging, especially without human intervention. In this work, we present an unsupervised deep learning framework for classifying cryo-EM/ET particle images that jointly optimizes for pose and structure through an autoencoder-based multi-stage pipeline. On single-particle cryo-EM datasets, our framework can capture the continuous variation in particle views and separate images of real particles from contamination. Using in silico mixtures of multiple types of proteins, we demonstrated our method's capability of separating the protein classes without supervision. Finally in a real cryo-ET dataset of algal chloroplast, our deep learning model successfully detected the four main protein complexes of photosynthesis on native thylakoid membranes. Taken together, these results demonstrate that our framework offers a scalable, annotation-free solution for robust structural discovery across diverse cryo-EM and cryo-ET applications.
zh_abstract: 冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）被广泛用于从纯化样品中解析蛋白质结构。借助冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-ET），可以对细胞薄切片成像，并在天然环境中直接观察多种蛋白质。然而，将细胞内大量不同类型蛋白质的混合物分离开来仍具挑战性，尤其是在没有人工干预的情况下。在本研究中，我们提出了一种用于对 cryo-EM/ET 颗粒图像进行分类的无监督深度学习框架，该框架通过基于自编码器的多阶段流程，对位姿和结构进行联合优化。在单颗粒 cryo-EM 数据集上，我们的框架能够捕捉颗粒视角的连续变化，并将真实颗粒的图像与污染物区分开来。利用多种蛋白质的计算机模拟混合物，我们证明了该方法能够在无监督条件下分离不同的蛋白质类别。最后，在一个真实的藻类叶绿体 cryo-ET 数据集中，我们的深度学习模型成功检测到天然类囊体膜上光合作用的四种主要蛋白复合物。综上，这些结果表明，我们的框架为各类 cryo-EM 和 cryo-ET 应用中稳健的结构发现提供了一种可扩展、无需标注的解决方案。

title: BenchmarkHub: an open-source platform for reproducible evaluation of large language models in healthcare
zh_title: BenchmarkHub：医疗大模型可复现评测的开源平台
summary: 开源平台（MIT许可），用固定种子抽题、记录完整提示与推理设置，支持语言与视觉语言模型及工具型智能体的可审计评测。

确定性规则评分并保存每次提示与结果

abstract: Background: Large language models (LLMs) are solely judged by their scores on biomedical benchmarks, yet these scores are rarely reproducible since the prompts, inference settings and model builds are seldom reported. We developed BenchmarkHub, an open-source platform for auditable evaluation of language and vision-language models for biomedical research. Methods: BenchmarkHub is a Python web application (Django 5.2, SQLite) released under the MIT licence and available at https://github.com/juanjuanignacio/benchmarkhub. The application can be accessed through a browser interface, a set of command-line tools and a REST API, so interactive exploration and scripted pipelines produce identical, comparable records. The platform samples questions with fixed seeds, runs models directly or as tool-using agents in a code sandbox, grades answers with deterministic rules and stores every prompt, reply and tool call. The interface provides a leaderboard to rank performance of the models, allowing model comparison without any preexisting programming knowledge. Findings: We used BenchmarkHub to evaluate 12 open-weight models in five experiments on 15 biomedical benchmarks (11 text, two multimodal and two computational biology) and two general benchmarks. The pooled accuracy ranged from 46.1% (95% CI 43.0-49.3) to 80.9% (78.3-83.3). Re-grading the responses with simple answer-extraction rules lowered a model's accuracy by up to 33.1 percentage points, leading to a reorder of the leaderboard. Published scores were found for 23 out of the 143 benchmark/model combinations tested. The accuracy measured by BenchmarkHub was lower than in the published results in 19 out of the 23 available comparisons. The effect of four prompting protocols (1: default prompt; 2: asking the model to answer the letter only; 3: chain-of-thought prompting; 4: three-shot prompting) changed MedQA accuracy by up to 11.3 points but was not significant after multiple-testing correction with 150 questions. We also tested the impact of ablation on benchmarking using the MMMU benchmark dataset. Removing images lowered the accuracy by 18.0 and 19.3 points respectively for the two strongest models. Finally, the accuracy of agentic benchmarks using a sandboxed interpreter increased on computational biology tasks by 36-63 points. title: HieraPTM: From PTM Site Recognition to Functional Phosphosite Prediction through Hierarchical Context and Protein Mechanics
zh_title: HieraPTM：从PTM位点识别到功能性磷酸化位点预测
summary: 提出分层跨任务框架，整合局部序列、蛋白语言模型表示与三维结构信息识别多种PTM，并经参数高效迁移预测功能性磷酸化位点。
key_points: HieraPTM融合序列、PLM与结构信息
HieraFuncPhos通过参数高效适配迁移表示
检索局部与远端力学证据用于功能优先级排序
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未见充分对比结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Protein post-translational modifications (PTMs) regulate cellular signaling and protein function, making accurate site identification essential for understanding protein regulation. However, PTM site recognition and functional phosphosite prediction are largely modeled independently, limiting the transfer of large-scale recognition knowledge to functional prioritization. Here, we introduce HieraPTM-HieraFuncPhos, a cross-task hierarchical framework that separately models and conditionally integrates transferable PTM recognition representations and function-specific mechanical evidence. HieraPTM integrates local sequence patterns, protein language model representations, and three-dimensional structural information to recognize multiple PTM types. HieraFuncPhos transfers these representations through parameter-efficient adaptation and adaptively retrieves local and distal mechanical evidence conditioned on functional representations. At HSP90AA1 T36 and T115, the model reveals distinct mechanical response patterns consistent with published nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) observations, suggesting that the framework not only prioritizes functional phosphosites but also provides biophysically grounded, testable hypotheses regarding site-specific regulation. HieraPTM achieved macro-averaged AUROC and AUPRC values of 0.9237 and 0.8425 across eight PTM tasks, while maintaining competitive performance on severely imbalanced external benchmarks. HieraFuncPhos achieved an AUROC of 0.8274 and an AUPRC of 0.8188, outperforming existing comparison methods. Together, this framework connects PTM site recognition, functional prioritization, and structure-informed hypotheses regarding potential regulatory processes.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质翻译后修饰（PTM）调控细胞信号传导和蛋白质功能，因此准确识别修饰位点对于理解蛋白质调控至关重要。然而，PTM位点识别与功能性磷酸化位点预测在很大程度上是各自独立建模的，限制了大规模识别知识向功能优先级排序的迁移。在此，我们提出HieraPTM-HieraFuncPhos，一种跨任务分层框架，分别建模并有条件地整合可迁移的PTM识别表征与功能特异性的力学证据。HieraPTM整合局部序列模式、蛋白质语言模型表征和三维结构信息，用于识别多种PTM类型。HieraFuncPhos通过参数高效的适配迁移这些表征，并在功能表征的条件下自适应地检索局部和远端的力学证据。在HSP90AA1的T36和T115位点，该模型揭示了与已发表的核磁共振（NMR）观察结果一致的不同力学响应模式，提示该框架不仅可对功能性磷酸化位点进行优先级排序，还能就位点特异性调控提供有生物物理学依据、可检验的假设。HieraPTM在八项PTM任务上的宏平均AUROC和AUPRC分别为0.9237和0.8425，同时在严重不平衡的外部基准上保持了有竞争力的性能。HieraFuncPhos的AUROC为0.8274，AUPRC为0.8188，优于现有对比方法。总体而言，该框架将PTM位点识别、功能优先级排序以及关于潜在调控过程的结构学假设联系在一起。

title: Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning for Uncertainty-Robust Multi-Label Chest X-ray Classification
zh_title: ReCaRL：面向不确定性的可靠性感知胸片多标签分类
summary: 提出图辅助框架，用训练标签关联构建可靠性加权、置信门控的更新，并以观测掩码处理不确定标注，评估含内部与外部判别。
key_points: 图由训练标签关联构建，避免僵化层级
观测掩码处理不确定标注
与平坦、加权、图及层级惩罚基线比较

abstract: Background: Automated multi-label classification of chest radiographs is complicated by overlapping imaging findings, noisy report-derived labels, and changes in disease co-occurrence across clinical settings. Existing clinical-hierarchy methods can encode label relationships, but a rigid hierarchy may conflate categorical membership with empirical association and propagate annotation errors. Methods: We investigated Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning (ReCaRL), a graph-assisted framework for multi-label chest radiograph classification. An image encoder produces initial finding scores, while a graph constructed from training-label associations provides reliability-weighted, confidence-gated updates. Uncertain annotations are handled with observation masks. The evaluation compares flat, weighted, graph-based, and hierarchy-penalty baselines, with internal and external discrimination and calibration assessments. Results: In the internal evaluation, ReCaRL achieved macro AUROC 0.821 and macro AUPRC 0.437, compared with 0.812 and 0.423 for the masked/weighted baseline. Mean AUROC across five common findings was 0.865 versus 0.858. External testing yielded AUROC 0.799 and AUPRC 0.409. Post-hoc calibration reduced the internal Brier score from 0.113 to 0.102 and the external expected calibration error from 0.082 to 0.061, without changing AUROC or AUPRC. Conclusions: Reliability-aware graph propagation and confidence gating were associated with modest improvements in multi-label chest radiograph classification relative to the matched masked/weighted baseline. Post-hoc calibration improved probability reliability in the reported evaluations. The findings do not establish a benefit in prospective clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: 【背景】胸部X线片的自动多标签分类因影像学表现重叠、来源于报告的标签存在噪声以及不同临床环境中疾病共现情况的变化而变得复杂。现有的临床层级方法可以编码标签之间的关系，但僵化的层级结构可能将类别归属与经验性关联混为一谈，并传播标注错误。【方法】我们研究了可靠性感知临床关系学习（ReCaRL），这是一种用于多标签胸部X线片分类的图辅助框架。图像编码器生成初始表现得分，而由训练标签关联构建的图则提供经可靠性加权、置信度门控的更新。不确定的标注通过观察掩码处理。评估比较了扁平、加权、基于图和层级惩罚的基线方法，并进行了内部和外部的区分度及校准评估。【结果】在内部评估中，ReCaRL的宏平均AUROC为0.821，宏平均AUPRC为0.437，而掩码/加权基线分别为0.812和0.423。五种常见表现的平均AUROC为0.865，对比0.858。外部测试的AUROC为0.799，AUPRC为0.409。事后校准使内部Brier评分从0.113降至0.102，外部期望校准误差从0.082降至0.061，且未改变AUROC或AUPRC。【结论】相对于匹配的掩码/加权基线，可靠性感知的图传播和置信度门控与多标签胸部X线片分类的适度改善相关。事后校准在所报告的评估中改善了概率可靠性。这些发现并不能证明其在前瞻性临床决策中的获益。

title: Affinity-guided design of PDZ-binding peptides in a shared latent space
summary: 提出在共享潜空间中以亲和力预测引导设计 PDZ 结合肽的深度学习方法，可兼顾单靶点、脱靶感知与双靶点目标。

abstract: PDZ-binding motifs (PBMs) are short C-terminal sequences that bind PDZ domains and contribute to protein localization and complex assembly. Designing PBMs could modulate these interactions while leaving most of the original protein sequence unchanged. Because PDZ recognition preferences overlap, modulating intended interactions requires considering off-target binding alongside target affinity. Computational PBM design methods generally use sequence-based affinity prediction and structure-based evaluation, but it remains challenging to guide sequence searches toward different binding objectives with a single trained model. Here, we propose a deep learning-based method to design PBMs by analytically formulating single-target, off-target-aware, and dual-target design objectives as directions in a PDZ-PBM shared latent space learned through quantitative PDZ-PBM affinity prediction. In single-target PBM redesign for DLG4-PDZ3, our method identified 100 top-ranked candidates, 84 of which were in the top 1% for experimentally measured interaction fitness in a published mutant library, compared with 64 using an existing method. In single-target de novo design of 10-residue PBMs, our method achieved the highest median in silico binding scores among the compared methods for three of the four PDZ domains tested. In off-target-aware and dual-target PBM design for PTPN3 and SCRIB-PDZ3, off-target-aware design increased between-group score differences within each domain at the cost of lower target-domain scores, whereas dual-target design yielded scores close to those of the respective single-target designs for both domains. Together, these results show that shared latent representations learned from quantitative affinities allow a single trained model to guide PBM design across different binding objectives without retraining.

abstract: [Clinical parkinsonism & related disorders] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as clinical support tools, yet their performance in Parkinson's disease (PD) management remains insufficiently characterized. We evaluated a general-purpose LLM (Gemini 1.5 Pro) and a medically specialized LLM (OpenEvidence) using 45 synthetic PD vignettes requiring generative assessment and management recommendations. Responses were independently rated by two movement disorders fellows using predefined 5-point Likert scales, with adjudication by a senior specialist when required. Both models demonstrated generally good performance in clinical assessment, whereas management recommendations were less reliable. A modest numerical advantage was observed for the medically specialized model across assessment, plan, and composite outcomes, although no statistically significant differences were identified. Qualitative analysis showed that clinically relevant errors occurred in both models, predominantly reflecting treatment strategy errors. These findings suggest that, in the specific model versions evaluated, LLMs may support clinical reasoning in PD, but require cautious interpretation, particularly for treatment recommendations.

title: Support-Constrained Offline Policy Improvement for Pediatric ECMO from Limited Clinical Data

summary: 提出FQI-SC离线强化学习框架，仅在有数据支持的状态-动作内优化，在78条儿童ECMO轨迹上评估。
key_points: 限制于经验支持的状态-动作对
低数据区默认沿用临床医生策略

abstract: Managing children on ECMO (Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation) requires balancing short-term physiological stability with the long-term goal of preventing neurological injury. Standard reinforcement learning can propose risky, out-of-distribution actions, while imitation learning is limited to reproducing clinician behavior. We introduce Support-Constrained Fitted Q-Iteration (FQI-SC), an offline reinforcement learning framework that cautiously improves upon expert behavior by restricting optimization to empirically supported state-action pairs and defaulting to the clinician baseline in low-data regions. On 78 pediatric trajectories totaling over 6,000 hours of clinical data, we evaluate our framework using Fitted Q-Evaluation (FQE) and a behavioral disagreement. Additionally, we formalize the performance-safety trade-off by introducing a unified Balance Score ($S(π)$). Our empirical evaluation shows that support-constrained policy improves the Balance Score by 38\% relative to FQI, improves estimated value by 1.28 FQE units over imitation learning, and reduces disagreement with clinician actions by 71\% relative to FQI.
zh_abstract: 对接受 ECMO（体外膜肺氧合）的儿童进行管理，需要在短期生理稳定与预防神经系统损伤的长期目标之间取得平衡。标准强化学习可能提出有风险的、超出分布范围的动作，而模仿学习则仅限于复现临床医生的行为。我们提出支持约束拟合 Q 迭代（Support-Constrained Fitted Q-Iteration，FQI-SC），这是一种离线强化学习框架：它将优化限制在经验上有数据支持的状态-动作对内，并在数据稀少的区域默认采用临床医生的基线策略，从而谨慎地在专家行为基础上加以改进。我们在 78 条儿科轨迹（总计超过 6,000 小时临床数据）上，使用拟合 Q 评估（Fitted Q-Evaluation，FQE）和行为分歧指标对该框架进行评估。此外，我们通过引入统一的平衡得分（Balance Score，$S(π)$）将性能与安全性之间的权衡形式化。我们的实证评估显示，与 FQI 相比，支持约束策略使平衡得分提高 38%；与模仿学习相比，估计价值提高 1.28 个 FQE 单位；与 FQI 相比，与临床医生动作的分歧减少 71%。

title: Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation: Differentiable Length Control for Concise Clinical Reasoning in Smaller Language Models
zh_title: PECA：小语言模型临床推理的可微简洁性适配
summary: 在QLoRA监督微调目标中加入单一可微简洁性项，以缓解小语言模型在医学任务中回答冗长的问题（预印本）。
key_points: 针对小模型医疗问答过长的问题
在QLoRA微调目标中加入可微长度项
无需偏好优化、奖励模型或专有教师
reason: 新方法但摘要无结果信息，属增量档
abstract: Smaller language models (SLMs) make it feasible to deploy clinical natural language processing where large proprietary models are too costly, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning allows them to be specialised on commodity hardware. One obstacle persists after training: on medical tasks these models answer at far greater length than the clinical question requires. In clinical decision support and point-of-care use, where time is short, such verbosity is hard to act on even when the underlying reasoning is sound. Existing length-control methods depend on preference optimisation, reward models, or proprietary teachers that undercut the accessibility making SLMs attractive. We introduce Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation (PECA), which adds a single differentiable conciseness term to the QLoRA supervised fine-tuning objective. Because the token count is discrete and non-differentiable, PECA instead raises the end-of-sequence probability once generation exceeds a token budget, a smooth signal optimised during ordinary training, with no preference data, no auxiliary model, and a single commodity GPU. On a 1.7-billion-parameter model fine-tuned on the medical-o1-reasoning-SFT corpus, PECA reduces mean response length by 72.8% while improving multiple-choice diagnostic accuracy from 40.8% to 44.0%. A sweep over the conciseness strength traces an interpretable accuracy-to-length frontier for balancing brevity and diagnostic completeness.
zh_abstract: 较小的语言模型（SLM）使得在大型专有模型成本过高的场景中部署临床自然语言处理成为可能，而参数高效微调则使其能够在普通硬件上完成专门化。但训练之后仍存在一个障碍：在医学任务上，这些模型的回答长度远超临床问题的实际所需。在临床决策支持和床旁使用场景中，时间紧迫，即使底层推理是合理的，这种冗长也难以付诸行动。现有的长度控制方法依赖偏好优化、奖励模型或专有教师模型，这削弱了使 SLM 具有吸引力的可及性。我们提出参数高效简洁性适配（Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation，PECA），它在 QLoRA 监督微调目标中加入单一的可微简洁性项。由于词元数量是离散且不可微的，PECA 转而在生成长度超过词元预算后提高序列结束符的概率，这是一种可在常规训练中优化的平滑信号，无需偏好数据、辅助模型，仅需一块普通 GPU。在 medical-o1-reasoning-SFT 语料上微调的 17 亿参数模型中，PECA 使平均回答长度减少 72.8%，同时将多项选择诊断准确率从 40.8% 提高到 44.0%。对简洁性强度进行扫描，可描绘出一条可解释的准确率—长度前沿，用于在简洁性与诊断完整性之间取得平衡。

title: Artificial intelligence-driven multiple sclerosis diagnosis using genomic and medical imaging data: a review.

abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Multiple Sclerosis (MS) is an immune-mediated central nervous system condition with heterogeneous clinical manifestations, progressive neurodegeneration, and considerable variability in disease trajectory. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly machine learning (ML) methods, have improved MS diagnosis and risk prediction. However, comprehensive review studies emphasizing the potential of existing AI-powered MS diagnosis remain limited. Thus, this study investigates the utilization of multimodal data by AI models to enhance diagnostic accuracy, evaluate disease progression, and optimize personalized care strategies. By adhering to PRISMA guidelines, this review included 26 studies encompassing MRI-based analysis, retinal OCT imaging, blood transcriptomics, SNP genotyping, and multimodal clinical datasets. An additional classification of these studies by modality was performed, and they were assessed with respect to dataset size, performance metrics, biomarkers, methodological robustness, and model interpretability. The findings indicate a consistent trend toward outstanding diagnostic performance, with some AI models achieving accuracies exceeding 95% using medical imaging and genomic data. However, limited external validation and interpretability procedures create a gap in clinical applicability and trustworthiness. This review highlights AI's growing potential to revolutionize MS diagnosis.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 多发性硬化（MS）是一种免疫介导的中枢神经系统疾病，临床表现异质，伴有进行性神经退行性变，疾病轨迹差异很大。人工智能（AI），尤其是机器学习（ML）方法的最新进展已改善了 MS 的诊断和风险预测。然而，强调现有 AI 驱动的 MS 诊断潜力的综合性综述研究仍然有限。因此，本研究探讨了 AI 模型利用多模态数据来提高诊断准确性、评估疾病进展并优化个体化照护策略。遵循 PRISMA 指南，本综述纳入了26项研究，涵盖基于 MRI 的分析、视网膜 OCT 成像、血液转录组学、SNP 基因分型及多模态临床数据集。我们另按数据模态对这些研究进行了分类，并从数据集规模、性能指标、生物标志物、方法学稳健性和模型可解释性方面进行了评估。结果表明，诊断性能总体上呈现出色趋势，一些 AI 模型利用医学影像和基因组数据的准确率超过95%。然而，外部验证和可解释性方法有限，造成了临床适用性和可信度方面的差距。本综述强调了 AI 在革新 MS 诊断方面日益增长的潜力。

title: Fine-Tuned Small Language Model for Synthetic Clinical Data Generation and Predictive Healthcare Analytics
summary: 提出基于微调 Phi-2 小语言模型生成合成临床数据，用于增强远程监测生命体征预测模型的训练数据。

key_points: 以微调 Phi-2 生成合成临床样本
用于缓解医疗数据稀缺与不平衡
目标是改进生命体征预测的深度学习模型
reason: 预印本，数据增强方法，摘要未见外部验证，属增量档
abstract: The reduced availability of medical datasets represents an important challenge in the development of predictive models for remote healthcare solutions, especially when the available data are imbalanced or difficult to extend through traditional methods. Small Language Models (SLMs) have become a promising alternative to Large Language Models (LLMs) for addressing these limitations due to their lower computational requirements and adaptability to specialized tasks. However, their performance remains highly dependent on the quality and representativeness of the available training data. In this paper, we propose a method for clinical data augmentation based on a fine-tuned Microsoft Phi-2 model that is used to generate synthetic instances, with the purpose of improving deep learning-based model for predicting remotely monitored vital signs. The Phi-2 model was adapted to the medical domain through supervised fine-tuning on the MedQuad dataset, through a Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA)-based method and by applying few-shot prompting techniques. The resulting model was used afterwards in the augmentation of a small-sized dataset, composed of vital sign values and labels associated with pathological and physiological states. The experimental results demonstrate that fine-tuned SLMs improved the performance on medical domain, achieving higher scores for both lexical (ROUGE) and semantic (BERTScore) evaluation metrics compared to the pretrained model. Moreover, the fine-tuned SLM is effective for generating structured synthetic clinical data. When used for data augmentation, the generated dataset improved the performance of a LSTM predictive model, increasing the classification accuracy from 89.0% to 93.7% and showing consistent improvements in precision, recall, and F1-score.
zh_abstract: 医学数据集可获得性降低，是为远程医疗解决方案开发预测模型时面临的一项重要挑战，尤其是在可用数据不平衡或难以通过传统方法扩充的情况下。小语言模型（Small Language Models，SLMs）因计算需求较低且易于适应专门任务，已成为应对这些局限的、可替代大语言模型（Large Language Models，LLMs）的有前景方案。然而，其性能仍高度依赖于可用训练数据的质量和代表性。本文提出一种基于微调的 Microsoft Phi-2 模型的临床数据增强方法，用于生成合成实例，以改进基于深度学习的远程监测生命体征预测模型。Phi-2 模型通过在 MedQuad 数据集上进行监督微调、采用基于量化低秩适配（Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation，QLoRA）的方法并应用少样本提示（few-shot prompting）技术，适配到医学领域。随后，该模型被用于扩充一个小规模数据集，该数据集由生命体征数值以及与病理和生理状态相关的标签组成。实验结果表明，微调后的 SLM 在医学领域的表现有所提升，与预训练模型相比，在词汇层面（ROUGE）和语义层面（BERTScore）的评估指标上均获得更高得分。此外，微调后的 SLM 能够有效生成结构化的合成临床数据。用于数据增强时，所生成的数据集提升了 LSTM 预测模型的性能，使分类准确率从 89.0% 提高到 93.7%，并且在精确率、召回率和 F1 分数上也呈现一致的提升。

title: A risk-aware individualized blood pressure target to avoid hypotension in surgery
summary: 提出在线个体化血压目标与去甲肾上腺素剂量选择方法，在4096例虚拟患者中对74%给出推荐，并在回顾性记录上评估校准。
zh_title: 术中避免低血压的风险感知个体化血压目标
key_points: 拟合简化PK/PD模型并传播不确定性
目标是使MAP低于65mmHg的风险受限
无合适目标时交还临床医生决策
reason: 预印本，虚拟患者与回顾性评估，无前瞻验证
abstract: We propose an online method for choosing both a blood pressure target and a norepinephrine dose for an individual surgical patient. From a short record of mean arterial pressure (MAP) and norepinephrine delivery, the method fits a reduced pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic model and uses a local Gaussian approximation to propagate uncertainty to future MAP readings. It searches for the lowest target for which a bolus and constant infusion keep the predicted probability of at least one MAP reading below 65 mmHg after the rise phase within a prescribed limit. If no such target is found, the decision returns to the clinician. We assess calibration of the predicted minimum MAP on retrospective surgical records under the doses actually administered. In a cohort of 4,096 virtual patients, the method recommended a dose for 74 % of patients at a nominal risk of 5 %. Among the patients receiving a recommendation, 6.9 % had a reading below 65 mmHg. A fixed target of 70 mmHg yielded a rate of 25 % when applied to the full virtual cohort.
zh_abstract: 我们提出一种在线方法，用于为个体手术患者同时选择血压目标和去甲肾上腺素剂量。该方法基于一小段平均动脉压（MAP）和去甲肾上腺素给药记录，拟合一个简化的药代动力学/药效动力学模型，并利用局部高斯近似将不确定性传递至未来的 MAP 读数。该方法搜索最低的血压目标，使得在采用一次推注加持续输注的情况下，上升阶段之后至少出现一次 MAP 读数低于 65 mmHg 的预测概率保持在规定限值之内。若找不到这样的目标，则将决策交还给临床医生。我们在回顾性手术记录上，针对实际给予的剂量，评估了预测最低 MAP 的校准情况。在 4,096 名虚拟患者的队列中，在名义风险为 5% 时，该方法为 74% 的患者推荐了剂量。在获得推荐的患者中，6.9% 出现了低于 65 mmHg 的读数。将固定目标 70 mmHg 应用于整个虚拟队列时，该比例为 25%。

abstract: Raysemble reconstructs eight lumbar and pelvic bones from a single X-ray by separating shape and placement. Each 3D query samples regional and global features at its image projection. A shared decoder predicts normalized bone shapes. Predicted depth and camera geometry determine 3D centers and scales for resampling these shapes onto a common grid in millimeters. Evaluation uses 23 held-out patients with 43 CT scans, each generating one simulated anteroposterior radiograph. Without rigid alignment to CT,Raysemble leads 15 evaluated methods, averaging 65.24% Dice, 9.09 mm HD95, and 3.32 mm ASSD over three random seeds. With identical inputs, it improves Dice over VolumeNeRF by 5.86 percentage points.

title: FGCARL: Fisher-Guided Continuously Adaptive Representation Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: FGCARL：用于医学图像分割的Fisher引导持续自适应表征学习
summary: 针对多中心域偏移与类别偏移并存的持续学习场景，提出医学图像分割方法以缓解灾难性遗忘。

abstract: Deep learning (DL) has achieved remarkable success in medical image segmentation by learning data-driven representations from large-scale annotated datasets. However, medical images are often collected independently across clinical sites, resulting in substantial domain shifts due to differences in imaging modalities, acquisition protocols, and intensity distributions. Meanwhile, segmentation classes may vary across sites due to differences in annotation standards, leading to class shifts. These evolving domains and class definitions can substantially degrade segmentation performance on newly encountered data, while sequential adaptation may cause catastrophic forgetting of knowledge acquired from previously encountered domains and classes. Existing incremental learning methods for medical image segmentation primarily address either domain shifts or class shifts, with these two settings largely investigated independently. This separation leaves a critical gap in developing a unified approach that can simultaneously adapt to evolving domains and newly introduced classes while retaining previously acquired knowledge. To address this challenge, we propose Fisher-Guided Continuously Adaptive Representation Learning, a unified framework for domain- and class-incremental 3D volumetric medical image segmentation. FGCARL comprises two key components: Mutual Adaptive Instance Representation (MAIR), which adaptively aligns feature distributions across sequentially encountered domains through bidirectional normalization and denormalization, and Fisher-Guided Knowledge Retention (FGKR), which selectively preserves parameters important for previously learned domains and classes through Fisher-guided regularization. Experimental results demonstrate that FGCARL consistently outperformed state-of-the-art methods, effectively adapting to domain and class shifts while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
zh_abstract: 深度学习（DL）通过从大规模标注数据集中学习数据驱动的表征，在医学图像分割中取得了显著成功。然而，医学图像往往由各临床中心独立采集，成像模态、采集方案和强度分布的差异导致显著的域偏移。同时，由于标注标准的差异，各中心的分割类别可能不同，从而造成类别偏移。这些不断演变的域和类别定义可能显著降低对新遇到数据的分割性能，而序贯适应还可能导致对先前遇到的域和类别所获知识的灾难性遗忘。现有用于医学图像分割的增量学习方法主要处理域偏移或类别偏移之一，这两种设置在很大程度上是被独立研究的。这种割裂在开发能够同时适应不断演变的域和新引入的类别、并保留先前所获知识的统一方法方面留下了关键空白。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Fisher 引导的持续自适应表征学习（Fisher-Guided Continuously Adaptive Representation Learning，FGCARL），这是一个用于域增量和类别增量三维体积医学图像分割的统一框架。FGCARL 包含两个关键组件：互适应实例表征（Mutual Adaptive Instance Representation，MAIR），通过双向归一化和反归一化，自适应地对齐序贯遇到的各域之间的特征分布；以及 Fisher 引导的知识保留（Fisher-Guided Knowledge Retention，FGKR），通过 Fisher 引导的正则化，选择性地保留对先前学习的域和类别重要的参数。实验结果表明，FGCARL 持续优于最先进的方法，能够有效适应域和类别偏移，同时减轻灾难性遗忘。

title: Towards Democratising Low-Data Medical Image Classification: CPU-Trainable ZACH-ViT and Its Geometric Variants

summary: 评估参数不足26万的ZACH-ViT四种几何头与紧凑MIL基线，在7个MedMNIST+及3个外部数据集的低数据设置下比较（预印本）。

abstract: Medical image classification in resource-constrained settings must contend with limited annotations and computational capacity. We evaluate four ZACH-ViT variants with linear, Euclidean prototype, Poincare and spherical heads alongside two compact multiple-instance-learning baselines. All models are trained from scratch with fewer than 260,000 parameters across seven MedMNIST+ datasets and three external benchmarks (PCam, ISIC2017 and Shenzhen tuberculosis radiographs). The low-data protocol uses 50 training images per class and five seeds, with validation-selected checkpoints at 23 and 47 epochs; a full-data reference uses one seed. Compact-TransMIL achieves the highest ten-dataset mean test Macro-F1 at 23 epochs (53.34%) and with full data (73.93%). At 47 epochs, ZACH-Linear narrowly leads (57.76% versus 57.54% for Compact-TransMIL). Extending training improves Macro-F1 in 239 of 300 paired comparisons. On ISIC2017, hZACH-Spherical has the highest 47-epoch low-data Macro-F1 (44.09% with SD 4.09%), whereas ZACH-EuclideanProto leads with full data (51.27%). We additionally conduct 40 CPU-only training runs on ISIC2017 and Shenzhen using four CPU threads; model-only single-image inference requires approximately 4-9 ms, while image decoding and preprocessing substantially increase end-to-end latency. The results demonstrate the feasibility of CPU-only training on the tested platform and the task- and regime-dependence of compact medical imaging under strict resource constraints.
zh_abstract: 资源受限环境下的医学图像分类必须应对标注有限和计算能力有限的问题。我们评估了四种 ZACH-ViT 变体（分别采用线性头、欧氏原型头、庞加莱头和球面头），以及两种紧凑型多示例学习基线。所有模型均从头训练，参数量少于 260,000，涵盖七个 MedMNIST+ 数据集和三个外部基准（PCam、ISIC2017 和深圳结核病胸片）。低数据方案每类使用 50 张训练图像和五个随机种子，在第 23 和 47 个训练轮次取验证选出的检查点；全数据参考使用一个随机种子。Compact-TransMIL 在 23 个轮次时（53.34%）以及全数据条件下（73.93%）取得最高的十个数据集平均测试 Macro-F1。在 47 个轮次时，ZACH-Linear 以微弱优势领先（57.76%，对比 Compact-TransMIL 的 57.54%）。延长训练在 300 次配对比较中的 239 次中提高了 Macro-F1。在 ISIC2017 上，hZACH-Spherical 在低数据 47 轮次时 Macro-F1 最高（44.09%，标准差 4.09%），而全数据条件下 ZACH-EuclideanProto 领先（51.27%）。我们还使用四个 CPU 线程，在 ISIC2017 和深圳数据集上进行了 40 次仅用 CPU 的训练；仅模型的单图推理约需 4–9 毫秒，而图像解码和预处理会显著增加端到端延迟。结果表明，在所测试的平台上仅用 CPU 训练是可行的，并且在严格资源约束下，紧凑型医学影像模型的表现依赖于任务和训练条件。

title: Distribution-First Framework for Learning Risk-Sensitive Individualized Treatment Rules
zh_title: 风险敏感个体化治疗规则的分布优先学习框架
summary: 先估计各治疗下的条件结局分布，再以插件方式评估分位数、CVaR等准则，统一学习风险敏感个体化治疗规则（预印本）。

abstract: Learning a risk-sensitive individualized treatment rule (ITR) with patient covariates is challenging when the treatment criterion depends on the full conditional outcome distribution rather than only its conditional mean. Existing methods are largely criterion-specific, making it difficult to compare multiple treatment criteria within a common pipeline, such as quantiles, conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), and complex preference-based objectives such as cumulative prospect theory. We propose a distribution-first framework for risk-sensitive ITR learning that first estimates treatment-specific conditional outcome distributions and then constructs the target ITR by plug-in criterion evaluation. The proposed framework unifies treatment rule learning across multiple criteria and accommodates hard-to-optimize objectives within the same estimation pipeline. On the theoretical side, it yields a general error propagation result for locally Hölder-stable criteria, linking first-stage distribution estimation error to downstream criterion estimation and treatment regret, together with sharper regret bounds under standard margin conditions. Empirically, we show that the proposed framework outperforms direct criterion-specific methods in multiple settings and further evaluate it on the ACTG175 HIV clinical trial, a randomized study comparing several antiretroviral regimens in HIV-infected adults.
zh_abstract: 当治疗标准取决于完整的条件结局分布而非仅取决于其条件均值时，利用患者协变量学习风险敏感的个体化治疗规则（ITR）具有挑战性。现有方法大多针对特定标准，难以在同一流程中比较多种治疗标准，例如分位数、条件风险价值（CVaR），以及累积前景理论等基于复杂偏好的目标。我们提出了一种“分布优先”的风险敏感 ITR 学习框架：首先估计各治疗的条件结局分布，然后通过插件式（plug-in）标准评估构建目标 ITR。该框架统一了多种标准下的治疗规则学习，并能在同一估计流程中处理难以优化的目标。在理论方面，该框架给出了针对局部 Hölder 稳定标准的一般误差传播结果，将第一阶段的分布估计误差与下游标准估计及治疗遗憾（regret）联系起来，并在标准边际条件（margin conditions）下给出了更紧的遗憾界。在实证方面，我们表明所提框架在多种情境下优于直接针对特定标准的方法，并进一步在 ACTG175 HIV 临床试验（一项比较 HIV 感染成人中几种抗逆转录病毒治疗方案的随机研究）上对其进行了评估。

title: Calibration and Conformal Prediction for Medical Question Answering in Arabic and English: Evidence from Two Non-Parallel Benchmarks

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly tested on medical exam questions, but accuracy alone does not show when an answer can be trusted. I study the calibration and uncertainty of two open-weight models, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Jais-adapted-7B-chat (both run in 4-bit precision), on 2,816 English multiple-choice questions from MedMCQA and 4,927 Arabic multiple-choice questions from MedAraBench. Accuracy was 0.561 (English) and 0.430 (Arabic) for Qwen, and 0.369 and 0.308 for Jais. Raw option probabilities were overconfident in all four settings (expected calibration error 0.242 to 0.486), and a single temperature parameter removed 82% to 93% of that error. Split conformal prediction reached its nominal coverage in all 24 settings I tested (within 0.006), but the sets were large when accuracy was low: at 90% coverage, temperature-scaled sets contained on average 63% (Qwen, English), 78% (Qwen, Arabic), 86% (Jais, English) and 89% (Jais, Arabic) of the options. The margin between the top two option probabilities separated correct from incorrect answers best for Qwen on English (AUROC 0.734) and worst for Jais on Arabic (0.579). Answering only the 20% most confident questions lowered Qwen's English error from 0.439 to 0.098. Jais showed a strong prior for option C (49% of English and 60% of Arabic predictions). Scoring Latin letters only cut the Arabic share to 29% but left accuracy, raw ECE and AUROC nearly unchanged. Because the two benchmarks differ in subject, level and number of options, I do not attribute differences between languages to language itself. Code is available at https://github.com/Mariyaaleem/arabic-english-medqa-uncertainty.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地接受医学考试题测试，但仅凭准确率无法说明何时可以信任某个答案。我研究了两个开放权重模型——Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Jais-adapted-7B-chat（均以 4 位精度运行）——在来自 MedMCQA 的 2,816 道英文多选题和来自 MedAraBench 的 4,927 道阿拉伯文多选题上的校准与不确定性。Qwen 的准确率在英文和阿拉伯文上分别为 0.561 和 0.430，Jais 分别为 0.369 和 0.308。原始选项概率在全部四种设置中均过度自信（期望校准误差为 0.242 至 0.486），而单个温度参数可消除其中 82% 至 93% 的误差。分割共形预测（split conformal prediction）在我测试的全部 24 种设置中均达到了名义覆盖率（偏差在 0.006 以内），但当准确率较低时预测集较大：在 90% 覆盖率下，经温度缩放的预测集平均包含选项总数的 63%（Qwen，英文）、78%（Qwen，阿拉伯文）、86%（Jais，英文）和 89%（Jais，阿拉伯文）。前两名选项概率之间的差值（margin）对区分正确与错误答案的效果，在 Qwen 英文上最好（AUROC 0.734），在 Jais 阿拉伯文上最差（0.579）。仅回答置信度最高的 20% 问题时，Qwen 的英文错误率从 0.439 降至 0.098。Jais 表现出对选项 C 的强烈先验偏好（英文预测的 49%、阿拉伯文预测的 60%）。仅对拉丁字母评分可将阿拉伯文中的这一比例降至 29%，但准确率、原始 ECE 和 AUROC 几乎不变。由于两个基准在学科、难度层级和选项数量上存在差异，我不将语言间的差异归因于语言本身。代码见 https://github.com/Mariyaaleem/arabic-english-medqa-uncertainty。

title: Ontology-Based SEA-CDM Integration for Vaccine Clinical Trials: Query, Similarity, and Design Recommendation

summary: 从AACT提取9,147条疫苗试验记录，映射到SEA-CDM并关联疫苗与不良事件本体，构建Neo4j知识图谱并评估三类应用。

abstract: ClinicalTrials.gov provides valuable information for vaccine research, but fragmented data structures and inconsistent vaccine naming complicate systematic cross-trial analysis. The Study-ExperimentAssay Common Data Model (SEA-CDM) provides a standardized structure for biomedical study data, while biomedical ontologies supply semantic relationships among concepts. We extracted 9,147 vaccinerelated study records from the Aggregate Analysis of ClinicalTrials.gov (AACT) database, mapped their records into SEA-CDM, and linked vaccine products and reported adverse events (AEs) to the Vaccine Ontology (VO) and Ontology of Adverse Events (OAE), respectively. Building on the existing Ontology-based SEA Network (OSEAN), we organized the integrated data into relational tables and a Neo4j knowledge graph while retaining links to original registrations. We evaluated three applications to assess semantic trial retrieval, context-aware AE ranking and trial similarity, and trial design recommendation. First, VO-based query expansion retrieved 41 candidate RNA vaccine trials compared with 16 using exact VO identifier matching. Second, a context-aware AE ranking model incorporating SEA-CDM features and VO-derived vaccine families improved recall@10 from 0.317 to 0.383 over a frequency-based baseline. TransE and CompGCN embeddings achieved Hits@10 of 0.950 and 0.946, respectively, for retrieving trials sharing the same VO identifier within disease-specific candidate sets. Third, an ontology-based clinical trial design recommendation model was developed using several machine learning methods under leave-one-Material-out evaluation across 23 vaccine classes, although performance varied across classes. These findings demonstrate how structural and semantic integration can support multiple clinical trial analyses using vaccine studies as a case study. This framework provides a foundation for extending ontology-supported data integration and analysis to other clinical research domains.

title: Spatial multi-omic profiling of non-autonomous transcriptomic and epigenomic responses to genetic perturbation

abstract: Multicellular organisms develop and maintain differentiated cell states through a combination of cell-autonomous and non-autonomous regulatory mechanisms, including signal transduction pathways mediated by ligands, receptors, and kinases. Genetic perturbation through CRISPR pooled screening is widely used to study cell-autonomous regulatory mechanisms, but the challenges of cellular-resolution in situ measurement have limited the study of non-autonomous regulatory mechanisms. We developed Perturb-Tags, a spatial multi-omic technique for pooled CRISPR screening that tags nuclei with spatial barcodes, allowing joint measurement of single-nucleus gene expression, CRISPR guide RNAs, chromatin accessibility, and spatial positions within intact tissue. Perturb-Tags achieves cellular-resolution, unbiased gene expression and multi-omic profiling, and higher sensitivity than previous spatial perturbation approaches. We used Perturb-Tags to systematically perturb ligands, receptors, and all expressed kinases in human embryoid bodies. These experiments revealed extensive non-autonomous gene expression changes after perturbation, including distance-dependent loss of signaling pathway activity upon ligand knockdown, compensatory upregulation of alternative signaling pathways, and responses to receptor and kinase knockdown that vary with cell microenvironment. We also identified changes in the spatial organization of cells with ligand and kinase knockdowns. Finally, we trained a graph neural network to model the combined effects of genetic perturbations on gene expression and chromatin accessibility across an entire tissue. Our work provides a powerful experimental and computational platform for mechanistic studies of non-autonomous regulatory mechanisms across healthy and diseased tissues.
zh_abstract: 多细胞生物通过细胞自主和非自主调控机制的结合来发育并维持分化的细胞状态，这些机制包括由配体、受体和激酶介导的信号转导通路。通过CRISPR混合筛选进行的遗传扰动被广泛用于研究细胞自主调控机制，但在细胞分辨率下进行原位测量的挑战限制了对非自主调控机制的研究。我们开发了Perturb-Tags，这是一种用于CRISPR混合筛选的空间多组学技术，它用空间条形码标记细胞核，从而能够在完整组织内联合测量单核基因表达、CRISPR向导RNA、染色质可及性和空间位置。Perturb-Tags实现了细胞分辨率、无偏倚的基因表达和多组学分析，且灵敏度高于以往的空间扰动方法。我们利用Perturb-Tags对人类拟胚体中的配体、受体和所有表达的激酶进行了系统性扰动。这些实验揭示了扰动后广泛的非自主基因表达变化，包括配体敲低后信号通路活性随距离而丧失、替代信号通路的代偿性上调，以及对受体和激酶敲低的反应随细胞微环境而异。我们还发现了配体和激酶敲低后细胞空间组织的变化。最后，我们训练了一个图神经网络，用于模拟遗传扰动对整个组织中基因表达和染色质可及性的综合影响。我们的工作为在健康和患病组织中研究非自主调控机制提供了一个强大的实验与计算平台。

title: Sepsis in 2026: from bundles to biology. A critical review.
source: PubMed · Revista espanola de quimioterapia : publicacion oficial de la Sociedad Espanola de Quimioterapia
