abstract: [Revista espanola de quimioterapia : publicacion oficial de la Sociedad Espanola de Quimioterapia] Sepsis remains associated with a substantial burden of morbidity and mortality despite more than two decades of Surviving Sepsis Campaign (SSC) recommendations. The 2026 update reinforces early recognition, resuscitation, timely antimicrobial therapy, source control, and reassessment, yet the benefit of increasingly intensive implementation of standardized measures may be approaching a ceiling. A central limitation is treating sepsis as a homogeneous entity despite the wide variation in etiologies, host susceptibility, immune responses, and clinical trajectories. Artificial intelligence, host-response biomarkers, rapid microbiological diagnosis, and pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic optimization provide new opportunities to shorten the time to effective intervention. In parallel, transcriptomic, genomic, and routine clinical data can identify subphenotypes and endotypes associated with different prognoses and potentially different treatment responses. Secondary analyses of clinical trials illustrate how an intervention that is neutral overall may be beneficial in biologically defined subgroups. The next step should combine SSC bundles with biological stratification, adaptive trial designs, and point-of-care tools capable of matching treatment to patient profile in real time. This review proposes a transition from standardized sepsis management toward precision medicine: the right treatment for the right patient at the right time.

title: Self-reported artificial intelligence use, knowledge, and perceptions among undergraduate medical students at a Peruvian university.

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in medical education, yet evidence regarding its actual use, knowledge, and perceptions among undergraduate medical students in Peru remains limited. This study aimed to estimate the prevalence of self-reported AI use for academic activities and to describe patterns of use, self-reported knowledge, and perceptions among undergraduate medical students at a Peruvian university, with an exploratory assessment of associated characteristics. We conducted an observational, analytical, cross-sectional study in 2024 among students enrolled at Universidad Ricardo Palma. A total of 279 responses were received; one respondent did not provide informed consent and was excluded, leaving 278 participants for analysis. Data were collected using an adapted online questionnaire based on previously published instruments. AI use was assessed through a separate yes/no question regarding previous use of any AI tool. Overall, 257 of 278 participants (92.4%) reported previous AI use for academic activities. Most participants self-reported basic knowledge of AI principles (89.2%) and awareness of its use in medicine (95.3%). Among the predefined AI-tool categories, ChatGPT (69.1%) and Canva (19.8%) were the most frequently reported. The primary contribution of this study is descriptive, documenting the prevalence and patterns of AI use, self-reported knowledge, and perceptions in the surveyed population. Secondary exploratory regression analyses suggested associations with daily digital-device use and perceptions regarding treatment planning, but these estimates should be interpreted cautiously because only 21 participants were classified as non-users. These findings highlight the need for structured education addressing critical, ethical, and responsible AI use in undergraduate medical training.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 人工智能（AI）在医学教育中的应用日益增多，但关于秘鲁医学本科生实际使用、知识和认知方面的证据仍然有限。本研究旨在估计自我报告的将AI用于学业活动的患病率，描述秘鲁某大学医学本科生的使用模式、自我报告的知识和认知，并对相关特征进行探索性评估。我们于2024年在Universidad Ricardo Palma在读学生中开展了一项观察性、分析性横断面研究。共收到279份回复；1名受访者未提供知情同意而被排除，最终278名参与者纳入分析。数据通过基于已发表工具改编的在线问卷收集。AI使用情况通过一个关于既往是否使用过任何AI工具的单独是/否问题进行评估。总体而言，278名参与者中有257人（92.4%）报告既往将AI用于学业活动。大多数参与者自我报告具备AI原理的基础知识（89.2%）并了解其在医学中的应用（95.3%）。在预先定义的AI工具类别中，ChatGPT（69.1%）和Canva（19.8%）是最常被报告的。本研究的主要贡献是描述性的，记录了被调查人群中AI使用的患病率和模式、自我报告的知识及认知。次要的探索性回归分析提示，AI使用与每日数字设备使用及对治疗计划的认知存在关联，但由于仅有21名参与者被归为非使用者，这些估计值应谨慎解读。这些发现凸显了在医学本科培训中开展针对批判性、符合伦理且负责任地使用AI的系统性教育的必要性。

abstract: [Exploratory research in clinical and social pharmacy] Self-medication is common worldwide and increasingly informed by artificial intelligence (AI) tools, but their intersection is understudied, particularly in conflict-affected settings such as Syria. To assess self-medication among adults living in Syria and their use of AI tools for medication-related information. An online cross-sectional survey of 255 adults (22 February-7 March 2026) assessed self-medication, AI use, trust, pharmacist-AI preferences, and privacy awareness. Analyses comprised descriptive statistics, chi-square tests with Cramér's V, and exploratory principal component analysis (PCA; n = 86 complete cases) with a sensitivity analysis (n = 149). Self-medication was reported by 80.8% of respondents, without a sex difference (p = 0.579), and 30.6% used antibiotics without prescription. AI tools were used for health queries by 61.6% (ChatGPT by 45.5% of all respondents), more often by younger (p = 0.002) and more educated respondents (p < 0.001). Among AI users, 66.2% asked medication-related questions, 68.2% trusted AI information conditionally, and 59.2% preferred pharmacists; in 16 of 17 disagreements, the pharmacist's advice was followed. PCA identified self-medication intensity, health literacy, and AI engagement components; the first two were reproduced in the sensitivity analysis, whereas a weak link between adverse drug reactions and AI engagement was not. In this digitally connected sample, AI-assisted health information seeking was common and coexisted with frequent self-medication and non-prescribed antibiotic use. These cross-sectional associations support digital health literacy initiatives, safeguards within AI platforms, and pharmacist engagement with AI-informed patients.

abstract: Detecting diabetes risk early is important for preventing disease progression. Most existing machine learning approaches focus on binary classification, which limits their ability to capture intermediate risk states such as prediabetes. We develop a supervised learning framework to classify adults as normal, prediabetic, or diabetic using National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data. The framework uses routinely collected demographic, clinical, and lifestyle variables from 15,356 adults, with glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) used only to define labels and excluded from input features to prevent leakage. We compare conventional machine learning and transformer-based models and examine two binary formulations: normal versus prediabetes, and normal versus combined prediabetes and diabetes. Models are evaluated on a held-out test set using precision, sensitivity, specificity, and F1 score. In the multiclass setting, performance is broadly consistent across models, with accuracy up to 0.72 and macro-averaged F1 of 0.70. Prediabetes remains the most challenging class, with F1 scores of 0.54 to 0.56 for conventional models and 0.53 to 0.55 for transformers, reflecting its overlap with both neighboring states. When the task is reduced to normal versus prediabetes, F1 scores rise modestly to 0.62 to 0.64. A more substantial improvement is observed under a broader screening formulation combining prediabetes and diabetes, with F1 scores of 0.73 to 0.74 across all models. These findings suggest that feature overlap along the biological continuum between normal and diabetic states contributes more to the difficulty of prediabetes detection than model architecture. Multiclass prediction provides a more clinically informative representation of metabolic risk progression but highlights a trade-off between clinically meaningful stratification and predictive accuracy.

abstract: Medieval French is one of the Romance vernacular languages with a significant history of transmission and an enormous influence on other vernacular languages of the time. The sources convey valuable knowledge about all aspects of culture. The study of Medieval French has, over the last few years, increasingly benefited from NLP-based methods. There have been numerous efforts to parse medieval French; however, these efforts use corpora comprising legal texts and -- primarily -- literary texts as their foundation and training data. This means that, except for juridical resources, scientific literature is overlooked. We present ALMeD, an annotated, semantically rich corpus (work-in-progress) of medical and surgical treatises produced in medieval French, i.e., Old and Middle French, including Anglo-Norman. Our semantically disambiguated gold standard goes beyond existing resources, focusing on medical terminology, and accounts for morphological development, evolving syntactical structures and the lack of spelling normalisation in these languages.
zh_abstract: 中古法语是罗曼语族的一种方言（俗语），有着重要的传承历史，并对当时的其他方言产生了巨大影响。这些文献资料传达了关于文化各方面的宝贵知识。近年来，中古法语研究越来越多地受益于基于自然语言处理（NLP）的方法。已有大量工作致力于对中古法语进行句法分析；然而，这些工作以法律文本以及——主要是——文学文本构成的语料库作为基础和训练数据。这意味着，除司法资料外，科学文献被忽视了。我们提出 ALMeD，这是一个经过标注、语义丰富的中古法语（即古法语和中古法语，包括盎格鲁-诺曼语）医学与外科论著语料库（进行中的工作）。我们经过语义消歧的金标准超越了现有资源，聚焦于医学术语，并兼顾这些语言的形态演变、不断变化的句法结构以及拼写缺乏规范化的情况。

abstract: Deep networks that estimate ground reaction forces and centers of pressure from motion-capture markers are validated within one laboratory, in a seldom-stated coordinate frame, and sometimes with trial-level splits that put the same person in the training and the test set. We measured what each practice costs, and whether such models transfer between laboratories. Three sequence models (convolutional, convolutional-recurrent, and convolutional-transformer) were evaluated on two independent datasets, locomotion (6 subjects) and occupational patient handling (10 subjects), under one pipeline, one tuning procedure, three seeds, and four protocols: trial-level split, leave-one-subject-out, pooled two-laboratory training with matched held-out subjects, and cross-laboratory transfer. At a fixed configuration, trial-level splits overstated the subject-held-out coefficient of determination by +0.040 to +0.194; on occupational data the overstatement exceeded every difference between architectures. With subjects held out, the three models reached values between 0.583 and 0.804; the leader differed between datasets, and gaps lay within subject-to-subject variability. Pooling the laboratories changed neither dataset on matched subjects. Transfer between laboratories was below chance in both directions, including the vertical force, which no in-plane rotation can affect. Leaving force targets in the plate frame while inputs were heading-aligned cost 0.57 of locomotion anteroposterior-force explained variance, enough to make that force look hardest; a Newton's-law correlation detected the mismatch before training. Split protocol and target frame changed reported accuracy more than architecture did. Learned force estimators should be validated with subjects held out, checked for frame consistency before training, and tested across laboratories before deployment claims are made.
zh_abstract: 根据动作捕捉标记点估计地面反作用力和压力中心的深度网络，通常在单一实验室内验证，所用坐标系很少明确说明，有时还采用试次层面的数据划分，使同一人同时出现在训练集和测试集中。我们衡量了每种做法的代价，以及此类模型能否在不同实验室之间迁移。在统一的流程、统一的调参程序、三个随机种子和四种方案下，我们在两个独立数据集——运动（6 名受试者）和职业性患者搬运（10 名受试者）——上评估了三种序列模型（卷积、卷积-循环和卷积-Transformer）。四种方案为：试次层面划分、留一受试者交叉验证、两实验室合并训练并匹配留出受试者，以及跨实验室迁移。在固定配置下，试次层面划分使留出受试者的决定系数被高估 +0.040 至 +0.194；在职业数据上，这一高估超过了各架构之间的所有差异。在留出受试者的条件下，三种模型的取值介于 0.583 和 0.804 之间；表现领先的模型在不同数据集间不同，且差距处于受试者间变异范围之内。合并两个实验室对匹配受试者上的任一数据集均无改变。实验室之间的迁移在两个方向上均低于随机水平，包括任何平面内旋转都无法影响的垂直力。当输入按朝向对齐而力目标仍保留在测力板坐标系时，运动数据前后向力的可解释方差损失 0.57，足以使该方向的力看起来最难估计；基于牛顿定律的相关性检验在训练前即可发现这种不匹配。数据划分方案和目标坐标系对所报告准确度的影响大于架构。学习型力估计器应在留出受试者的条件下验证，在训练前检查坐标系一致性，并在提出部署主张之前进行跨实验室测试。

title: Robot-Induced Bias in Movement Smoothness Metrics for Rehabilitation: Quantification and Correction in Simulation

abstract: Robot mechanics can bias kinematic measures of recovery and limit comparisons across rehabilitation devices. We developed a closed-loop human-robot simulation calibrated to published healthy and stroke group kinematics. Paired runs held motor-control parameters and movement plans fixed to quantify bias in seven metrics relative to a low-impedance reference, normalized using external repeatability benchmarks. Within a subset informed by published device specifications, median log dimensionless jerk (LDLJ) bias was 0.93 and 1.79 benchmark units for stroke and healthy profiles, respectively. Sobol analysis identified Coulomb friction and apparent mass as leading contributors; LDLJ bias persisted across 11 robustness variants. LDLJ bias increased as simulated movements became less fragmented. If recovery similarly reduces fragmentation, this effect could partly mask improvement in measured smoothness. Correction combining identified robot dynamics and observed metrics with gradient-boosted trees reduced median normalized absolute error from 0.77 to 0.10 for LDLJ and from 0.24 to 0.08 for spectral arc length (SPARC) in the device-informed subset of a random 20% hold-out. Median smoothness residuals remained at or below 0.15 benchmark units across four separately held-out parameter regions. Under an alternative controller, LDLJ error decreased from 1.60 to 0.17 without retraining, although transfer varied across metrics. These simulation results support mechanical characterization and movement-dependent correction toward more comparable robotic assessments, motivating validation in patients.
zh_abstract: 机器人力学特性可能使恢复的运动学测量产生偏差，并限制不同康复设备之间的比较。我们开发了一个闭环人-机器人仿真，并根据已发表的健康人群和卒中人群组的运动学数据进行了校准。配对运行保持运动控制参数和运动计划不变，以量化七项指标相对于低阻抗参照的偏差，并使用外部重复性基准进行归一化。在依据已发表设备规格选取的子集中，卒中和健康特征下对数无量纲加加速度（LDLJ）偏差的中位数分别为 0.93 和 1.79 个基准单位。Sobol 分析确定库仑摩擦和表观质量为主要贡献因素；LDLJ 偏差在 11 种稳健性变体中持续存在。随着仿真运动的碎片化程度降低，LDLJ 偏差增大。如果恢复同样会降低碎片化程度，这一效应可能部分掩盖所测平滑度的改善。将已识别的机器人动力学与观测指标相结合并采用梯度提升树进行校正后，在随机 20% 留出集的设备依据子集中，LDLJ 的归一化绝对误差中位数从 0.77 降至 0.10，频谱弧长（SPARC）从 0.24 降至 0.08。在四个单独留出的参数区域中，平滑度残差中位数均保持在 0.15 个基准单位或以下。在另一种控制器下，无需重新训练，LDLJ 误差从 1.60 降至 0.17，但不同指标间的迁移情况有所不同。这些仿真结果支持开展力学特性表征和依赖运动的校正，以实现更具可比性的机器人评估，并提示需要在患者中进行验证。
